items.title_en: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
items.abstract_en: Deeper neural networks are more difficult to train. We present a residual learning framework to ease the training of networks that are substantially deeper than those used previously. We explicitly reformulate the layers as learning residual functions with reference to the layer inputs, instead of learning unreferenced functions. We provide comprehensive empirical evidence showing that these residual networks are easier to optimize, and can gain accuracy from considerably increased depth. On the ImageNet dataset we evaluate residual nets with a depth of up to 152 layers---8x deeper than VGG nets but still having lower complexity. An ensemble of these residual nets achieves 3.57% error on the ImageNet test set. This result won the 1st place on the ILSVRC 2015 classification task. We also present analysis on CIFAR-10 with 100 and 1000 layers. The depth of representations is of central importance for many visual recognition tasks. Solely due to our extremely deep representations, we obtain a 28% relative improvement on the COCO object detection dataset. Deep residual nets are foundations of our submissions to ILSVRC & COCO 2015 competitions, where we also won the 1st places on the tasks of ImageNet detection, ImageNet localization, COCO detection, and COCO segmentation.

items.title_zh: 用于图像识别的深度残差学习
items.abstract_zh: 更深的神经网络更难训练。我们提出残差学习框架，以缓解训练比以往深得多的网络的困难。我们把网络层显式地重新表述为学习相对于层输入的残差函数，而非学习无参照的函数。大量实证表明，残差网络更易优化，并能从显著增加的深度中获得精度提升。在 ImageNet 上我们评估了深达 152 层的残差网络——比 VGG 深 8 倍而复杂度更低；其集成在测试集上取得 3.57% 的错误率，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 分类任务第一名。我们还在 CIFAR-10 上分析了 100 层与 1000 层的网络。表征深度对许多视觉识别任务至关重要，仅因极深的表征，我们在 COCO 目标检测上获得 28% 的相对提升。深度残差网络是我们参加 ILSVRC 与 COCO 2015 竞赛的基础，我们还另获 ImageNet 检测、定位及 COCO 检测、分割任务的第一名。
items.highlight_zh: 残差连接让 152 层网络更易训练并夺得 ILSVRC 冠军
items.digest_zh: 研究问题：深度学习界普遍相信“网络越深越强”，但层数堆到一定程度后，训练误差反而上升——这不是过拟合，而是优化本身变难了。方法：作者提出残差学习：让若干层不去直接拟合目标映射 H(x)，而是拟合残差 F(x)=H(x)-x，前向时再把输入 x 加回来，形成“捷径连接”。这样做几乎不增加参数与计算量，却让梯度更容易回传，深层网络因此变得可训练。结果：在 ImageNet 上训练了 18 至 152 层的 ResNet，152 层版本比 VGG 深 8 倍而复杂度更低；网络集成在测试集上达到 3.57% 的错误率并夺得 ILSVRC 2015 分类冠军，在 CIFAR-10 上甚至成功训练了 1000 层网络。意义：残差结构此后成为极深网络的通用骨架，并被移植到检测、分割等任务（COCO 上带来 28% 的相对提升），深刻影响了后续视觉乃至其它领域的模型设计。

items.title_en: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
items.abstract_en: Abstract Proteins are essential to life, and understanding their structure can facilitate a mechanistic understanding of their function. Through an enormous experimental effort 1–4 , the structures of around 100,000 unique proteins have been determined 5 , but this represents a small fraction of the billions of known protein sequences 6,7 . Structural coverage is bottlenecked by the months to years of painstaking effort required to determine a single protein structure. Accurate computational approaches are needed to address this gap and to enable large-scale structural bioinformatics. Predicting the three-dimensional structure that a protein will adopt based solely on its amino acid sequence—the structure prediction component of the ‘protein folding problem’ 8 —has been an important open research problem for more than 50 years 9 . Despite recent progress 10–14 , existing methods fall far short of atomic accuracy, especially when no homologous structure is available. Here we provide the first computational method that can regularly predict protein structures with atomic accuracy even in cases in which no similar structure is known. We validated an entirely redesigned version of our neural network-based model, AlphaFold, in the challenging 14th Critical Assessment of protein Structure Prediction (CASP14) 15 , demonstrating accuracy competitive with experimental structures in a majority of cases and greatly outperforming other methods. Underpinning the latest version of AlphaFold is a novel machine learning approach that incorporates physical and biological knowledge about protein structure, leveraging multi-sequence alignments, into the design of the deep learning algorithm.

items.title_zh: 使用 AlphaFold 进行高精度蛋白质结构预测
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质对生命至关重要，理解其结构有助于从机制上认识其功能。实验已测定约 10 万个蛋白质结构，但相比已知的数十亿条序列仍只占很小比例，测定单个结构往往需要数月到数年，成为结构覆盖的瓶颈。仅凭氨基酸序列预测三维结构这一“蛋白质折叠问题”的核心部分，已悬置 50 余年，现有方法在无同源结构时远达不到原子级精度。本文提出首个能在无相似结构可参考时仍常规给出原子级精度预测的计算方法：完全重新设计的神经网络模型 AlphaFold 在 CASP14 盲测中多数情况下精度可与实验结构媲美，并大幅优于其他方法；其关键在于把关于蛋白质结构的物理与生物学知识（含多序列比对信息）融入深度学习算法设计。
items.highlight_zh: 无同源结构也能达到原子级精度的蛋白质结构预测
items.digest_zh: 研究问题：蛋白质的三维结构决定其功能，但实验测定（如 X 射线晶体学、冷冻电镜）一个结构往往要花数月到数年；已知蛋白质序列有数十亿条，已解出结构的仅约 10 万个，缺口巨大。仅凭氨基酸序列预测结构的“蛋白质折叠问题”已悬置 50 多年，此前方法在缺乏同源模板时远达不到原子级精度。方法：作者彻底重新设计神经网络模型 AlphaFold，把关于蛋白质结构的物理与生物学先验——尤其是多序列比对（MSA）中蕴含的共进化信息——融入深度学习架构，端到端地从序列直接输出原子坐标。结果：在 CASP14 盲测中，多数靶点的预测精度可与实验结构相媲美，并大幅领先其他参赛方法，这是首个能在无同源结构时仍常规给出原子级精度的计算手段。意义：它把获取结构的成本从“实验年月”压缩到“计算小时”，为大规模结构生物信息学、药物发现与功能注释打开了新局面。

items.title_en: All-Optical Machine Learning Using Diffractive Deep Neural Networks
items.abstract_en: We introduce an all-optical Diffractive Deep Neural Network (D2NN) architecture that can learn to implement various functions after deep learning-based design of passive diffractive layers that work collectively. We experimentally demonstrated the success of this framework by creating 3D-printed D2NNs that learned to implement handwritten digit classification and the function of an imaging lens at terahertz spectrum. With the existing plethora of 3D-printing and other lithographic fabrication methods as well as spatial-light-modulators, this all-optical deep learning framework can perform, at the speed of light, various complex functions that computer-based neural networks can implement, and will find applications in all-optical image analysis, feature detection and object classification, also enabling new camera designs and optical components that can learn to perform unique tasks using D2NNs.

items.title_zh: 使用衍射深度神经网络的全光机器学习
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种全光衍射深度神经网络（D2NN）架构：在用深度学习设计出协同工作的被动衍射层之后，该架构可学习实现多种功能。我们通过 3D 打印的 D2NN 在实验上验证了这一框架的成功：在太赫兹波段，器件学会了完成手写数字分类以及成像透镜的功能。借助现有的多种 3D 打印与其他光刻制造方法以及空间光调制器，这一全光深度学习框架能以光速执行计算机神经网络所能实现的多种复杂功能，并将应用于全光图像分析、特征检测与目标分类，还可催生能借助 D2NN 学习执行独特任务的新型相机设计与光学元件。
items.highlight_zh: 3D 打印衍射层让光本身直接完成神经网络计算
items.digest_zh: 研究问题：主流神经网络依赖电子芯片计算，速度与能耗受限。能否让“光”本身完成神经网络的运算？方法：作者提出衍射深度神经网络（D2NN）：把网络的多层“权重”实现为一叠被动衍射光学层，每层由大量可训练的相位与振幅调制像素组成；光穿过各层时被逐点调制，并在层间自由空间中传播、发生干涉，相当于完成了乘加式的线性变换与非线性作用。这些层的参数先在计算机上用深度学习反向传播训练好，再用 3D 打印等方式制成实体器件。结果：在太赫兹波段，作者打印出实物 D2NN，成功实现了手写数字分类，并实现了成像透镜的功能，验证了框架可行。意义：该方案无需供电、以光速并行处理，可用于全光图像分析、特征检测与目标分类，也为“可学习”的相机与光学元件开辟了新思路；局限在于器件一旦制成功能即固定，任务须在设计制造阶段确定。

items.title_en: XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System
items.abstract_en: Tree boosting is a highly effective and widely used machine learning method. In this paper, we describe a scalable end-to-end tree boosting system called XGBoost, which is used widely by data scientists to achieve state-of-the-art results on many machine learning challenges. We propose a novel sparsity-aware algorithm for sparse data and weighted quantile sketch for approximate tree learning. More importantly, we provide insights on cache access patterns, data compression and sharding to build a scalable tree boosting system. By combining these insights, XGBoost scales beyond billions of examples using far fewer resources than existing systems.

items.title_zh: XGBoost：一个可扩展的树提升系统
items.abstract_zh: 树提升是一种极为有效且被广泛使用的机器学习方法。本文介绍一个可扩展的端到端树提升系统 XGBoost，数据科学家广泛使用它在众多机器学习挑战中取得最先进的结果。我们提出面向稀疏数据的新型稀疏感知算法，以及用于近似树学习的带权分位点草图。更重要的是，我们给出了关于缓存访问模式、数据压缩与分片的洞见，用以构建可扩展的树提升系统。综合这些设计，XGBoost 能以远少于现有系统的资源扩展到数十亿级样本。
items.highlight_zh: 稀疏感知与近似分裂让提升树扩展到十亿级样本
items.digest_zh: 研究问题：梯度提升树精度高、应用广，但面对超大规模、高度稀疏的数据时，如何同时兼顾训练速度、内存占用与可扩展性？方法：作者构建了端到端的可扩展树提升系统 XGBoost，关键技术包括：面向稀疏数据的稀疏感知算法，能自动学习缺失值应走的最优默认分支方向；带权分位点草图，用于在近似树学习中高效寻找分裂点；以及对缓存访问模式、数据压缩与数据分片的系统性工程优化，使并行与分布式训练更加高效。结果：这些设计组合起来，让 XGBoost 在远少于既有系统的资源下即可扩展到数十亿级样本，并在众多机器学习竞赛与任务上取得当时最好的成绩。意义：它把“提升树”从一种算法变成可靠易用的工业级工具，长期是数据科学竞赛与表格数据建模的默认基线之一，其稀疏感知与近似分裂思路也被后续系统广泛借鉴。

items.title_en: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
items.abstract_en: We introduce a new language representation model called BERT, which stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers. Unlike recent language representation models, BERT is designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on both left and right context in all layers. As a result, the pre-trained BERT model can be fine-tuned with just one additional output layer to create state-of-the-art models for a wide range of tasks, such as question answering and language inference, without substantial task-specific architecture modifications. BERT is conceptually simple and empirically powerful. It obtains new state-of-the-art results on eleven natural language processing tasks, including pushing the GLUE score to 80.5% (7.7% point absolute improvement), MultiNLI accuracy to 86.7% (4.6% absolute improvement), SQuAD v1.1 question answering Test F1 to 93.2 (1.5 point absolute improvement) and SQuAD v2.0 Test F1 to 83.1 (5.1 point absolute improvement).

items.title_zh: BERT：用于语言理解的深度双向 Transformer 预训练
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种新的语言表示模型 BERT，即基于 Transformer 的双向编码器表示。与近期的语言表示模型不同，BERT 通过在所有层中同时联合左右上下文，从未标注文本中预训练深度双向表示。因此，预训练的 BERT 模型只需增加一个输出层进行微调，无需对任务特定架构做大幅修改，就能在问答、语言推断等广泛任务上构建最先进的模型。BERT 概念简单而实证有力，在十一个自然语言处理任务上取得新的最优结果，包括将 GLUE 分数推至 80.5%（绝对提升 7.7 个百分点）、MultiNLI 准确率提升至 86.7%（绝对提升 4.6）、SQuAD v1.1 问答测试 F1 达 93.2（绝对提升 1.5）、SQuAD v2.0 测试 F1 达 83.1（绝对提升 5.1）。
items.highlight_zh: 双向预训练加单层微调，刷新 11 项 NLP 任务纪录
items.digest_zh:
研究的问题：在 BERT 之前，语言模型预训练多为单向（从左到右）或浅层双向拼接，模型无法同时利用一个词的左右两侧上下文，限制了对语义的理解。
方法：BERT 用 Transformer 编码器做「掩码语言建模」——随机遮住句中部分词，让模型根据左右两侧全部上下文去猜，从而在每一层都实现真正的双向表示；同时用「下一句预测」任务学习句子间关系。预训练完成后，只需在顶部加一个简单输出层，用小规模标注数据微调，即可适配各类下游任务，无需大改网络结构。
结果：在 11 项自然语言处理任务上刷新纪录，GLUE 基准达 80.5%（绝对提升 7.7 个百分点），MultiNLI 准确率 86.7%，SQuAD v1.1 问答 F1 达 93.2，SQuAD v2.0 达 83.1。
为何重要：它确立了「大规模无标注预训练 + 轻量微调」这一范式，把自然语言处理从每个任务单独设计模型，推向统一的通用底座，成为后来几乎所有语言模型的标准做法。

items.title_en: ORB-SLAM3: An Accurate Open-Source Library for Visual, Visual-Inertial and Multi-Map SLAM
items.abstract_en: This paper presents ORB-SLAM3, the first system able to perform visual, visual-inertial and multi-map SLAM with monocular, stereo and RGB-D cameras, using pin-hole and fisheye lens models. The first main novelty is a feature-based tightly-integrated visual-inertial SLAM system that fully relies on Maximum-a-Posteriori (MAP) estimation, even during the IMU initialization phase. The result is a system that operates robustly in real-time, in small and large, indoor and outdoor environments, and is 2 to 5 times more accurate than previous approaches. The second main novelty is a multiple map system that relies on a new place recognition method with improved recall. Thanks to it, ORB-SLAM3 is able to survive to long periods of poor visual information: when it gets lost, it starts a new map that will be seamlessly merged with previous maps when revisiting mapped areas. Compared with visual odometry systems that only use information from the last few seconds, ORB-SLAM3 is the first system able to reuse in all the algorithm stages all previous information. This allows to include in bundle adjustment co-visible keyframes, that provide high parallax observations boosting accuracy, even if they are widely separated in time or if they come from a previous mapping session. Our experiments show that, in all sensor configurations, ORB-SLAM3 is as robust as the best systems available in the literature, and significantly more accurate. Notably, our stereo-inertial SLAM achieves an average accuracy of 3.6 cm on the EuRoC drone and 9 mm under quick hand-held motions in the room of TUM-VI dataset, a setting representative of AR/VR scenarios. For the benefit of the community we make public the source code.

items.title_zh: ORB-SLAM3：面向视觉、视觉惯性与多地图 SLAM 的高精度开源库
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 ORB-SLAM3，首个仅用单目、双目或 RGB-D 相机（支持针孔与鱼眼镜头模型）即可完成视觉、视觉惯性与多地图 SLAM 的系统。其一，紧耦合的基于特征的视觉惯性 SLAM 完全依赖最大后验（MAP）估计，包括 IMU 初始化阶段，可在室内外大小场景中实时稳健运行，精度较以往方法高 2 至 5 倍。其二，基于高召回场景识别的新型多地图系统，使系统在视觉信息长期贫乏时仍能工作：跟丢即新建地图，重访时无缝合并。与只用最近几秒信息的视觉里程计不同，它首次在所有算法阶段复用全部历史信息，把时间上远隔、甚至来自早前建图会话的共视关键帧纳入光束法平差。实验显示各传感器配置下稳健性媲美最优系统且显著更精确，双目惯性在 EuRoC 无人机上平均精度 3.6 cm，TUM-VI 快速手持运动下达 9 mm。代码已公开。
items.highlight_zh: 首个统一视觉、视觉惯性与多地图的 SLAM 系统，精度高 2–5 倍
items.digest_zh:
研究的问题：机器人和 AR 设备需要靠相机（可加 IMU）同时定位并建图，但已有系统往往只支持单一传感器配置，且在纹理缺失、快速运动或长时间运行后容易跟丢、无法恢复。
方法：作者构建统一的基于特征的 SLAM 框架，把视觉与惯性信息紧耦合，整个流程（包括 IMU 初始化）都用最大后验（MAP）估计统一求解；同时引入召回率更高的场景识别，支持「多地图」：跟丢时新建子地图，回到旧区域时自动无缝合并。此外，系统在所有阶段复用历史信息，把时间上相隔很远的关键帧也纳入光束法平差，以获得大视差观测。
结果：支持单目、双目、RGB-D 相机及针孔、鱼眼镜头。精度比以往方法高 2 至 5 倍；双目惯性在 EuRoC 无人机数据上平均 3.6 厘米，在 TUM-VI 快速手持运动场景下达 9 毫米。
为何重要：它首次把视觉、视觉惯性与多地图能力整合进一个开源系统，并且长期稳健，成为该领域广泛使用的基准与工具，对机器人与 AR/VR 落地意义重大。

items.title_en: Ropedia Xperience 2: A Gold Standard for Scaling Physical AI Environments and Behaviors
items.title_zh: Ropedia Xperience 2：面向物理 AI 环境与行为规模化的黄金标准数据集
items.abstract_en: Large foundation models such as GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 have recently been shown to control robots directly from visual observations. They nevertheless remain brittle on long-horizon, contact-rich tasks in real-world environments. Further progress depends on two complementary resources: demonstrations of human behavior that supervise how tasks are performed, and interactive environments in which policies can be rolled out, evaluated, and improved in closed loop. Language models have advanced along well-characterized scaling laws; the corresponding question for physical AI is how capability scales with environments and behaviors, which first requires identifying which data to scale and how to produce and reuse such data continuously. To address this question, we introduce Ropedia Xperience 2, comprising 1,589 released metric-scale 3D scans and a collection of 4,230 egocentric recordings of 74 tasks (131 hours). We further show that each capture can be repurposed for robot learning: scenes are converted into physically interactive simulation environments, human motion is retargeted to whole-body robot trajectories, and additional robot behaviors are obtained through virtual teleoperation and automated long-horizon trajectory generation. We propose this joint capture of environments and behaviors as a gold standard for physical AI data collection, laying a data foundation for establishing scaling laws over environments and behaviors.
items.abstract_zh: GPT-6 Astra、Claude Fable 5.1 等大型基础模型近期已被证明可直接从视觉观测控制机器人，但在真实环境的长时程、富接触任务上仍然脆弱。进一步进展依赖两类互补资源：监督任务如何执行的人类行为演示，以及可闭环推演、评估与改进策略的交互式环境。语言模型已有清晰的规模定律，物理 AI 的对应问题则是能力如何随环境与行为规模扩展，而这首先需要确定扩展哪些数据、如何持续生产与复用。为此我们推出 Ropedia Xperience 2，包含 1,589 个公开发布的米制尺度 3D 扫描，以及 74 项任务、共 131 小时的 4,230 段第一人称录制。我们进一步证明每段采集都可转化为机器人学习资源：场景转为可物理交互的仿真环境，人体运动重定向为全身机器人轨迹，并通过虚拟遥操作与自动化长时程轨迹生成获得更多机器人行为。我们提出这种环境与行为的联合采集作为物理 AI 数据收集的黄金标准，为建立跨环境与行为的规模定律奠定数据基础。
items.highlight_zh: 环境与行为联合采集，为物理 AI 规模定律奠基
items.digest_zh:
研究的问题：大型基础模型已能直接从画面控制机器人，但在真实世界长时程、接触密集的任务上仍很脆弱。要变强，需要两类数据：人类演示（告诉机器任务怎么做）和可交互环境（让策略能反复试错、评估与改进）。语言模型有明确的规模定律，物理 AI 则还不知道能力如何随「环境数量」和「行为数量」增长。
方法：作者发布 Ropedia Xperience 2 数据集，包含 1,589 个米制尺度的 3D 场景扫描，以及 74 项任务、4,230 段第一人称录制（共 131 小时）。关键点是「一采多用」：每个场景被转换成可物理交互的仿真环境；人体动作被重定向为全身机器人轨迹；再通过虚拟遥操作与自动化长时程轨迹生成，衍生出更多机器人行为。
结果：一次采集同时产出环境数据与行为数据，并可持续扩增，形成可复用的数据生产流水线。
为何重要：论文主张「环境与行为联合采集」应成为物理 AI 数据的黄金标准，为研究物理 AI 的规模定律（像语言模型那样）打下数据基础，这是从「模型更大」转向「数据更对」的关键一步。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: DynamicsPLM: A Dynamics-Enriched Small Protein Language Model for Protein Variant Effect Prediction
items.title_zh: DynamicsPLM：面向蛋白质变体效应预测的动力学增强小型蛋白质语言模型
items.abstract_en: Predicting how mutations impact protein function and stability remains a key challenge in computational biology. Current state-of-the-art protein language models (PLMs) primarily scale parameter size on sequence corpora to capture evolutionary constraints but remain blind to the explicit physical dynamics of folded proteins. Conversely, models trained strictly on physical dynamics neglect critical evolutionary sequence statistics. In this paper, we bridge this gap by introducing DynamicsPLM, a highly parameter-efficient 35-million-parameter model that unifies evolutionary and biophysical representation learning. Utilizing a second-stage, multi-task continual pretraining strategy on over 60,000 proteins, we enrich a foundational sequence encoder with explicit residue-level and pairwise molecular dynamics heads while preserving its original evolutionary knowledge. At inference, DynamicsPLM computes zero-shot mutation effects from sequence alone by balancing an evolutionary plausibility score against a structural dynamics disruption score. Across the massive ProteinGym benchmark and natural variants of the Tsuboyama folding stability dataset, DynamicsPLM achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among all models under 100M parameters, and matches or outperforms several billion-scale sequence-based models of its size. Our findings demonstrate that explicit structural-dynamics supervision provides a parameter-efficient alternative to raw scale. Availability: All codes including data preparation scripts, training and validation recipes, and experimental configurations for LoMuS are available at: https://github.com/kabir-ai2bio-lab/DynamicsPLM.
items.abstract_zh: 预测突变如何影响蛋白质功能与稳定性是计算生物学的关键难题。当前最先进的蛋白质语言模型（PLM）主要在序列语料上扩大参数量以捕捉进化约束，却对折叠蛋白的显式物理动力学一无所知；反之，仅用物理动力学训练的模型又忽略关键的进化序列统计。本文提出 DynamicsPLM，一个仅 3500 万参数、极具参数效率的模型，统一进化与生物物理表征学习。我们在 6 万余个蛋白质上采用第二阶段多任务持续预训练，为序列编码器加入显式的残基级与成对分子动力学预测头，同时保留其原有进化知识。推理时仅凭序列即可计算零样本突变效应，即在进化合理性得分与结构动力学扰动得分之间取得平衡。在 ProteinGym 大规模基准与 Tsuboyama 折叠稳定性数据集的天然变体上，DynamicsPLM 在所有 1 亿参数以下模型中达到最优精度，并可媲美或超越若干同量级的十亿级序列模型。结果表明显式结构动力学监督可作为参数规模的替代方案。
items.highlight_zh: 3500 万参数以动力学监督替代规模扩张，零样本突变预测达 SOTA
items.digest_zh:
研究的问题：蛋白质语言模型擅长从海量序列中学习进化规律，据此预测突变的影响，但它们看不到蛋白质折叠后的实际物理动态；反过来，只靠分子动力学模拟训练的模型又丢弃了宝贵的进化信息。如何兼得？
方法：作者提出 DynamicsPLM，一个只有 3500 万参数的小模型。做法是先沿用已有序列编码器的进化知识，再在 6 万余个蛋白质上做第二阶段多任务持续预训练，额外接上残基级与成对（两两残基之间）的分子动力学预测头，从而把「结构会怎么动」这一物理信息注入模型，同时不遗忘原有进化知识。推理时只看序列：分别计算一个进化合理性分数和一个结构动力学扰动分数，二者平衡后得到零样本突变效应预测。
结果：在 ProteinGym 大规模基准和 Tsuboyama 折叠稳定性数据集的天然变体上，它在所有 1 亿参数以下模型中精度最好，并能与部分同量级的十亿级序列模型持平或胜出。
为何重要：这说明给模型加上显式的结构动力学监督，可以成为「堆参数」之外更省算力的路线，对小数据、低算力的蛋白工程与变异解读尤其有价值。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。

items.title_en: Asymmetric Frequency Conversion and Violation of Kirchhoff's Law of Thermal Radiation in Phased Floquet Metasurfaces
items.title_zh: 相位Floquet超表面中的非对称频率转换与热辐射基尔霍夫定律的违背
items.abstract_en: We study a system of three closely spaced conducting sheets, whose thermal emission largely violates Kirchhoff's law through nonreciprocal frequency conversion enabled by Floquet phenomena. We leverage surface mode transitions controlled by temporal modulation of one of the metasurfaces, resulting in largely asymmetric frequency conversion. Our findings broaden the capabilities of Floquet metasurfaces for wave conversion and energy manipulation, paving the way towards magnet-free nonreciprocal photonic devices with opportunities for thermal management and efficient photonic refrigeration.
items.abstract_zh: 本文研究了由三片间距很近的导电极板构成的系统，借助Floquet效应实现的非互易频率转换，其热辐射在很大程度上违背了基尔霍夫定律。作者通过对其中一层超表面施加时间调制来控制表面模式的转变，从而实现高度非对称的频率转换。该发现拓展了Floquet超表面在波转换与能量调控方面的能力，为无需磁场的非互易光子器件开辟了道路，并在热管理与高效光子制冷方面具有潜在应用。
items.highlight_zh: 时间调制超表面实现非互易频率转换，使热辐射违背基尔霍夫定律
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：基尔霍夫定律指出，物体在给定波长和方向上的热辐射率等于其同条件下的吸收率。要让热辐射“违反”这一定律，就必须打破时间反演对称性，传统做法依赖外加磁场，代价高且难以集成。本文追问：能否仅靠时间调制实现这一点？

方法：作者构建了一个由三层彼此靠得很近的导电极板组成的结构，其中一层是相位式（phased）Floquet超表面，通过随时间周期性地调制其电磁响应，使系统的表面模式发生转变。这种时变调制带来的Floquet散射过程可以把入射的热辐射能量以非互易的方式转移到其他频率上，从而使发射与吸收在频率上不再对应，即出现非对称的频率转换。

结果：数值分析表明，该系统在热发射上明显偏离基尔霍夫定律，且频率转换具有很大的非对称性——能量在某些频率方向上被强烈转换，而在相反方向则几乎不发生。

意义：该工作把“非互易”从依赖磁性材料转变为依赖时间调制，为无需磁场的非互易光子器件提供了新思路。这类效应可用于定向热管理、热辐射调控，以及光子制冷等需要打破发射-吸收平衡的场景，也拓展了Floquet超表面在波转换与能量操控方面的功能边界。

items.title_en: Factored One-sided Adam-Moment for Practical and Scalable SOAP
items.title_zh: 因子化单边Adam矩：通向实用可扩展SOAP的轻量方案
items.abstract_en: Second-order optimizers (e.g., Shampoo, SOAP) have emerged as compelling alternatives to Adam/AdamW and promise faster per-step convergence than AdamW in transformer training. However, they still remain costly in practice, and even SOAP still pays substantial optimizer-state memory and eigendecomposition overhead. We ask whether the benefits of SOAP can be retained at nearly the efficiency of AdamW. In this paper, we answer yes with a lightweight SOAP variant, Factored One-sided Adam-Moment (FOAM). The path to practical impact is twofold: first, FOAM employs input-only preconditioning, dropping the output-side Kronecker factor to reduce memory and remove one eigendecomposition. The Kronecker structure of the Hessian shows that this is exact for a diagonal output-side curvature and nearly lossless for a near-diagonal one, as we observe empirically. Second, FOAM replaces SOAP's dense rotated second moment with a factored Adam-moment estimator based on row-by-column statistics. Under the K-FAC Fisher assumption with a diagonal output curvature, this estimator exactly recovers SOAP's dense second moment, and we measure only a 15-20% K-FAC violation, with negligible effect on the update. Our empirical results support the claim that FOAM matches strong SOAP and Muon baselines in validation loss across scales of large language model (LLM) pre-training, uses half of SOAP's optimizer state, runs at Muon-class wall-clock time, and retains robustness across a three-fold learning-rate range. The results hold from 124M to 760M parameters, demonstrating that SOAP's gains need not require SOAP's cost. Code: https://github.com/naver-ai/foam
items.abstract_zh: 二阶优化器（如Shampoo、SOAP）被视为Adam/AdamW的有力替代，在Transformer训练中可实现更快的每步收敛，但实际中仍代价高昂，SOAP仍需承担可观的优化器状态内存与特征分解开销。本文提出轻量变体FOAM（因子化单边Adam矩），回答能否以接近AdamW的效率保留SOAP的收益。FOAM采用仅输入侧预条件，去掉输出侧Kronecker因子，从而减少内存并省去一次特征分解；同时用基于行、列统计的因子化Adam矩估计替代SOAP的稠密旋转二阶矩。实验表明，在124M至760M参数的大语言模型预训练中，FOAM的验证损失与强SOAP、Muon基线相当，优化器状态仅为SOAP的一半，实际耗时达Muon级别，并在三倍学习率范围内保持稳健。
items.highlight_zh: 单边预条件加因子化Adam矩，以一半内存达到SOAP效果
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：AdamW是大模型训练的主流优化器，而Shampoo、SOAP等二阶优化器理论上每步收敛更快，却因为要存储巨大的预条件矩阵、频繁做特征分解而难以实用。本文要问：能否在几乎不增加开销的前提下拿到SOAP的好处？

方法：作者提出FOAM，做了两处简化。第一，只对输入侧做预条件，丢掉输出侧的Kronecker因子。依据Hessian的Kronecker结构，当输出侧曲率近似对角时这一简化是精确或近乎无损的，作者也在实验中观察到了这种近似对角性。第二，用一个基于“行统计+列统计”的因子化Adam矩估计，替代SOAP中稠密的、需要旋转坐标的二阶矩。在K-FAC Fisher假设且输出曲率对角的条件下，该估计可精确还原SOAP的稠密二阶矩。

结果：实测K-FAC违背程度仅15%–20%，对参数更新的影响可以忽略。在124M到760M参数的大语言模型预训练中，FOAM的验证损失与强SOAP和Muon基线持平；优化器状态只需SOAP的一半；实际运行时间达到Muon级别；学习率在3倍范围内变化仍然稳健。

意义：这说明二阶优化的收益不必以二阶优化的代价换取，为大规模训练提供了一条更省内存、更易部署的升级路径，“SOAP的增益不必付出SOAP的成本”是本文的核心主张。

items.title_en: Actor, Judge, or Teacher? Understanding Decision Models in Long-Horizon Agents
items.title_zh: 行动者、评判者还是教师？理解长程智能体中的决策模型
items.abstract_en: Decision models answer a question with a typed output, such as a choice among options with a probability for each, so one model can choose an agent's actions, evaluate actions already taken, or score every action to teach a policy with reinforcement learning. Prior work has studied them mainly as actors, judging their usefulness by how well they act. We ask whether a decision model that acts poorly can still teach well. We compare three decision models and three general LLMs as actors and judges on ALFWorld, and use JEV as a teacher on ALFWorld and WebShop. As actors, all six models are pulled away from a subgoal that must come first by an easier one. As judges that see the whole trajectory, the same models credit the steps toward that subgoal, and asking whether each action helped, rather than whether the task will succeed, separates useful from useless actions. As a teacher, JEV raises a Qwen2.5-1.5B policy over GRPO from 72.8% to 82.9% success on ALFWorld and from 56.8% to 71.4% on WebShop. These results suggest that a poor actor can still teach well, because judging an action after the episode ends reveals the consequences that acting must anticipate. Code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/decision-agents.
items.abstract_zh: 决策模型以带类型的输出回答问题，例如在若干选项中选择一个并给出各自概率，因此同一模型既可充当智能体的行动者，也可评估已执行的动作，或为强化学习策略对每个动作打分以充当教师。以往工作主要把它们当作行动者，以行动好坏衡量其价值。本文追问：一个行动能力很差的决策模型是否仍能教得好？作者在ALFWorld上比较了三个决策模型与三个通用大语言模型作为行动者和评判者的表现，并以JEV作为教师在ALFWorld和WebShop上做实验。结果显示，作为行动者，六个模型都会被更简单的子目标吸引而偏离必须先完成的子目标；而作为能看到完整轨迹的评判者，同一批模型却能正确归功于通向该子目标的步骤，且询问“每个动作是否有帮助”比询问“任务是否会成功”更能区分有用与无用动作。作为教师，JEV使基于GRPO训练的Qwen2.5-1.5B策略在ALFWorld上从72.8%提升到82.9%，在WebShop上从56.8%提升到71.4%。这表明糟糕的行动者仍可能是好教师：回合结束后评判动作，能揭示行动时必须预判的后果。
items.highlight_zh: 行动差的模型仍可当教师，事后评判动作可大幅提升策略
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：在长程智能体任务中，“决策模型”输出的是带类型的答案（比如给每个候选动作一个概率），因此它其实可以扮演三种角色：直接行动的行动者、评估已发生动作的评判者、给每个动作打分以指导强化学习的教师。以往研究几乎只把它当行动者，用行动表现来评判其价值。本文提出的关键问题是：行动能力差的模型，是不是也能当个好老师？

方法：作者在ALFWorld环境上把3个决策模型和3个通用大语言模型分别当作行动者和评判者进行比较，并把JEV模型作为教师，在ALFWorld和WebShop上训练一个小策略模型。他们还设计了一个巧妙对照：把评判问题从“任务最终会不会成功”改为“这一步动作是否有帮助”。

结果：作为行动者时，六个模型都会犯同一种错误——被更容易实现的子目标吸引，从而偏离必须先完成的那个子目标。但作为能看到整条轨迹的评判者，同一批模型却能正确地把功劳归给迈向关键子目标的步骤，说明它们“知道该做什么，只是做不到”。作为教师，JEV让Qwen2.5-1.5B策略在GRPO基础上从72.8%提升到82.9%（ALFWorld），从56.8%提升到71.4%（WebShop）。

意义：这提示我们不应只用行动表现来筛选模型。回合结束后回看整条轨迹去评判单个动作，能揭示行动时难以预判的后果，因此“教师”角色对模型能力的要求低于“行动者”角色，为利用能力有限的开源模型训练强策略提供了实用路线。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对数据划分、基线、消融与计算预算；结果的适用范围以原文实验为准。

items.title_en: FAST-LIO2: Fast Direct LiDAR-inertial Odometry
items.abstract_en: This paper presents FAST-LIO2: a fast, robust, and versatile LiDAR-inertial odometry framework. Building on a highly efficient tightly-coupled iterated Kalman filter, FAST-LIO2 has two key novelties that allow fast, robust, and accurate LiDAR navigation (and mapping). The first one is directly registering raw points to the map (and subsequently update the map, i.e., mapping) without extracting features. This enables the exploitation of subtle features in the environment and hence increases the accuracy. The elimination of a hand-engineered feature extraction module also makes it naturally adaptable to emerging LiDARs of different scanning patterns; The second main novelty is maintaining a map by an incremental k-d tree data structure, ikd-Tree, that enables incremental updates (i.e., point insertion, delete) and dynamic re-balancing. Compared with existing dynamic data structures (octree, R*-tree, nanoflann k-d tree), ikd-Tree achieves superior overall performance while naturally supports downsampling on the tree. We conduct an exhaustive benchmark comparison in 19 sequences from a variety of open LiDAR datasets. FAST-LIO2 achieves consistently higher accuracy at a much lower computation load than other state-of-the-art LiDAR-inertial navigation systems. Various real-world experiments on solid-state LiDARs with small FoV are also conducted. Overall, FAST-LIO2 is computationally-efficient (e.g., up to 100 Hz odometry and mapping in large outdoor environments), robust (e.g., reliable pose estimation in cluttered indoor environments with rotation up to 1000 deg/s), versatile (i.e., applicable to both multi-line spinning and solid-state LiDARs, UAV and handheld platforms, and Intel and ARM-based processors), while still achieving higher accuracy than existing methods. Our implementation of the system FAST-LIO2, and the data structure ikd-Tree are both open-sourced on Github.

items.title_zh: FAST-LIO2：快速直接激光雷达-惯性里程计
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出FAST-LIO2，一个快速、鲁棒且通用的激光雷达-惯性里程计框架。它建立在高效的紧耦合迭代卡尔曼滤波之上，并有两个关键创新：其一，直接将原始点云配准到地图（并随之更新地图，即建图），无需提取特征，从而能利用环境中的细微结构提高精度，也天然适配不同扫描模式的新型激光雷达；其二，使用增量式k-d树数据结构ikd-Tree维护地图，支持点的插入、删除等增量更新与动态重平衡，相比八叉树、R*-tree、nanoflann k-d树综合性能更优，并天然支持树上降采样。作者在多个公开激光雷达数据集的19个序列上做了详尽基准对比，FAST-LIO2以远低的计算量获得一致更高的精度，并在小视场固态激光雷达的真实实验中得到验证；其可在大型室外场景达到最高100 Hz的里程计与建图，在杂乱室内环境中以高达1000 deg/s的旋转仍能可靠估计位姿，适用于多线与固态激光雷达、无人机与手持平台以及Intel和ARM处理器。
items.highlight_zh: 原始点直接配准加增量k-d树，百赫兹鲁棒激光惯性里程计
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：激光雷达-惯性里程计要在没有GPS的环境中实时估计载体位姿并同步建图。以往方法通常先从点云中手工提取边缘、平面等特征再做配准，这一环节既丢失了环境中的细微信息，又依赖特定扫描模式，换一种激光雷达就要重新设计；同时地图维护的数据结构在大场景下更新缓慢。如何兼顾速度、精度与通用性？

方法：FAST-LIO2有两大改动。第一是“直接法”——不提取任何特征，把原始点直接配准到地图，配准后又把新点写回地图，省去手工特征模块，自然适配不同扫描模式的激光雷达。第二是自研的增量式k-d树ikd-Tree，支持点的插入与删除并进行动态重平衡，还天然支持在树上做降采样，使地图更新随新帧到来而增量完成，而非每帧重建。整体框架仍是紧耦合的迭代卡尔曼滤波，惯性测量提供运动先验。

结果：作者在多个公开数据集的19个序列上做了穷尽式基准测试，FAST-LIO2的精度稳定高于其他先进系统，计算量却低得多；在大型室外场景可达最高100 Hz的里程计与建图；在杂乱室内环境中即使旋转角速度高达1000 deg/s仍能可靠输出位姿；并在小视场固态激光雷达上做了真实实验。

意义：它把“去特征化”和“增量式地图”结合，让一套系统同时覆盖多线旋转式与固态激光雷达、无人机与手持平台、Intel与ARM处理器，为实时机器人导航与建图提供了一个又快又通用又鲁棒的基础方案。

items.title_en: PhysLoop: Harnessing LLMs' Physics Awareness for Self-Improving Video Generation Models
items.title_zh: PhysLoop：利用大语言模型的物理常识实现视频生成模型的自我改进
items.abstract_en: Video generation models produce visually realistic videos but still struggle with physical dynamics and causal consistency. Learning from generated videos requires fine-grained physical supervision, yet reliable quality judgments, correction pairs, and controlled variations are difficult to obtain. Large language models (LLMs) possess physical knowledge, but struggle to reliably guide video generation models in producing their training videos. We present PhysLoop, a unified harness designed to support physically grounded self-improvement in video generation models. The harness guides and constrains LLMs throughout video generation, selection, and correction, distilling their physical knowledge into physically consistent videos. The framework supports controllable training-data construction and inference-time video repair. By identifying and correcting failures, PhysLoop marks a key milestone toward recursive self-improvement (RSI) in video generation models with limited human intervention. We release 100K videos spanning diverse, realistic indoor and outdoor scenes, along with generation tools and two evaluation datasets: PhysLoop-Gen and PhysLoop-Repair. We evaluate controllable generation and localized repair on these datasets, respectively, and assess physical behavior on the external Physics-IQ Verified benchmark.
items.abstract_zh: 视频生成模型能产出视觉逼真的视频，但在物理动力学与因果一致性上仍有欠缺。从生成视频中学习需要细粒度的物理监督，而可靠的质量判断、纠正配对与受控变化都难以获得。大语言模型（LLM）虽具备物理知识，却难以可靠地指导视频生成模型产出其训练所需视频。为此我们提出 PhysLoop：一个统一的“挽具”（harness），在视频的生成、筛选与纠正全过程中引导并约束 LLM，把其物理知识蒸馏为物理一致的视频，支持可控训练数据构建与推理阶段视频修复。通过识别并纠正失败，PhysLoop 朝着有限人工干预下视频生成模型的递归自我改进（RSI）迈出关键一步。我们发布 10 万条覆盖多样真实室内外场景的视频、相应生成工具，以及 PhysLoop-Gen 与 PhysLoop-Repair 两个评测数据集，并在外部 Physics-IQ Verified 基准上评估物理行为。
items.highlight_zh: 让 LLM 当物理老师，闭环纠正视频生成模型
items.digest_zh:
① 研究问题：现在的视频生成模型画面很逼真，却不懂物理——物体下落、碰撞、因果先后常出错。想让模型“看自己生成的视频来学物理”，就得知道哪段好、哪里错、怎么改，而这些监督信号极难自动获得。LLM 脑子里有物理常识，但让它直接指挥视频模型并不好用。
② 方法：PhysLoop 是一个统一框架，把 LLM 嵌进“生成—筛选—纠正”的闭环，用它的物理知识既当老师又当裁判，把知识蒸馏成物理一致的视频。它既能构造可控的训练数据，也能在推理阶段对视频做局部修复。
③ 结果：作者发布 10 万条视频（覆盖多样的真实室内外场景）、生成工具，以及两个数据集——PhysLoop-Gen 用于可控生成评测、PhysLoop-Repair 用于局部修复评测，并在外部 Physics-IQ Verified 基准上检验物理表现。
④ 意义：它让“模型靠自己的产物变强、少人工干预”的递归自我改进（RSI）在视频生成领域迈出可操作的一步，也为物理常识如何注入生成模型提供了可复用的工程范式。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: Deep learning-guided discovery reveals the diversity and mutational potential of environmental beta-lactamases
items.title_zh: 深度学习引导的挖掘揭示环境β-内酰胺酶的多样性与突变潜力
items.abstract_en: Beta-lactamases are a major mechanism of bacterial resistance to beta-lactam antibiotics; however, their functional diversity and mutational potential in environmental microbial communities remain partially understood. This study aimed to characterize environmental beta-lactamase diversity and investigate how sequence variation influences antibiotic resistance. By integrating protein language model (PLMs) with ensemble learning, we identified more than 46,000 putative beta-lactamases across all four Ambler classes from environmental metagenomes, widely distributed across diverse habitats, with distinct habitat-associated class compositions. The candidates sharing approximately 30% sequence identity with known beta-lactamases conferred resistance to multiple beta-lactam antibiotics when expressed in Escherichia coli. Combining inverse folding model with PLMs further identified mutations that altered resistance profiles, including substitutions that increased resistance to carbapenems. Predicted high-fitness sites exhibited greater natural sequence variability overall, with higher variability in wastewater-derived than ocean-derived enzymes. These findings reveal undercharacterized beta-lactamase diversity and substantial mutational flexibility in environmental microbiomes, providing a basis for investigating their potential contribution to the diversification of antibiotic resistance.
items.abstract_zh: β-内酰胺酶是细菌耐受β-内酰胺类抗生素的主要机制，但环境微生物群落中该类酶的功能多样性与突变潜力仍未充分认识。本研究旨在刻画环境β-内酰胺酶的多样性，并探究序列变异如何影响耐药性。我们结合蛋白质语言模型（PLM）与集成学习，从环境宏基因组中鉴定出超过 46,000 个推定的β-内酰胺酶，覆盖 Ambler 全部四类，广泛分布于多种生境，且不同生境具有不同的类别组成。与已知酶序列同一性仅约 30% 的候选酶在大肠杆菌中表达后可赋予对多种β-内酰胺类抗生素的耐药性。结合反向折叠模型与 PLM 进一步识别出可改变耐药谱的突变，包括提高碳青霉烯类耐药性的替换。预测的高适应度位点整体上呈现更高的天然序列变异度，且废水来源的酶变异度高于海洋来源。这些发现揭示了环境微生物组中未被充分表征的β-内酰胺酶多样性与可观的突变灵活性，为研究其对耐药性多样化的潜在贡献奠定基础。
items.highlight_zh: 从环境宏基因组挖出逾4.6万个潜在β-内酰胺酶
items.digest_zh:
① 研究问题：β-内酰胺酶是细菌对抗青霉素、头孢菌素等抗生素的主力武器，但自然界（土壤、水体、废水等）里还藏着多少种、能变异到什么程度，人们所知有限。
② 方法：作者把蛋白质语言模型（PLM）与集成学习结合，直接从环境宏基因组序列中“挖”候选酶；再用反向折叠模型配合 PLM 预测哪些氨基酸替换会改变耐药表现。
③ 结果：共找到逾 46,000 个候选β-内酰胺酶，覆盖 Ambler 全部四个类别，分布广泛且不同生境类别组成各异；与已知酶只有约 30% 序列同一性的“远亲”在大肠杆菌中表达后，仍能抵抗多种β-内酰胺类抗生素。预测的突变可改变耐药谱，其中包括增强对碳青霉烯类（临床“最后防线”药物）的耐药。高适应度位点在自然界中本身变异更丰富，废水来源的酶比海洋来源更易变。
④ 意义：说明环境微生物组是耐药基因的巨大“蓄水池”和变异试验场，为耐药性监测与风险评估提供了候选清单和计算工具。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。

items.title_en: Inverse Design of an On-chip Phase-Change Switch Composed of Sparse Heterogeneous Metasurfaces
items.title_zh: 基于稀疏异质超表面的片上相变光开关逆向设计
items.abstract_en: Photonic switches are exploited for optical signal routing and control within optical communication systems. The integration of phase change materials with silicon photonic switches overcomes the drawbacks of the state-of-the-art photonic switches based on electro-optic and thermo-optic effects. In this work, a 1x2 on-chip switch with a footprint of 6.3umx31um based on on-chip one-dimensional metasurfaces is inverse-designed. The on-chip metasurfaces are heterogeneous, which their meta-atoms can be composed of either SiO2 or the phase-change material Sb2Se3. This helps to the realization of higher extinction ratio between the switch outputs, especially at the amorphous state which has a small refractive index contrast to that of the silicon. To benefit from structural, fabrication and switching simplicity, sparse parameterization is followed in the inverse design of the switch using ternary search (TS) and particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithms.
items.abstract_zh: 光子开关用于光通信系统中的光信号路由与控制。将相变材料与硅光子开关集成，可克服基于电光与热光效应的现有光开关的缺点。本工作逆向设计了一款尺寸为 6.3 μm×31 μm 的 1×2 片上开关，基于片上一维超表面。该超表面是异质的：其超原子可由 SiO2 或相变材料 Sb2Se3 构成，这有助于在开关两路输出之间获得更高的消光比，尤其是在与硅折射率对比很小的非晶态下。为兼顾结构、制造与切换的简便性，开关的逆向设计采用稀疏参数化，并结合三分搜索（TS）与粒子群优化（PSO）算法。
items.highlight_zh: 异质超原子+Sb2Se3，逆向设计紧凑片上光开关
items.digest_zh:
① 研究问题：光通信芯片里需要能切换光路的光开关。传统方案靠电光或热光效应，体积大、功耗高、串扰多；把相变材料与硅光集成是更优路线，但相变材料非晶态与硅的折射率差别很小，开关“关断”时很难做出高消光比。
② 方法：作者逆向设计了一款 1×2 片上开关，尺寸仅 6.3 μm×31 μm，基于一维片上超表面。其巧妙之处是“异质”：每个超原子既可做成 SiO2，也可做成相变材料 Sb2Se3，通过两种材料的搭配来拉大两路输出的差异、提升消光比。为让结构简单、易加工、易切换，设计采用稀疏参数化，并用三分搜索（TS）与粒子群优化（PSO）联合寻优。
③ 结果：得到结构紧凑、制造与切换都较简单的片上开关设计，并阐明异质超原子在提升消光比方面的作用（原文未给出具体消光比数值）。
④ 意义：展示了“逆向设计＋相变材料＋异质超表面”组合在可重构光子集成器件中的潜力，为下一代低功耗光路由提供思路。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对数据划分、基线、消融与计算预算；结果的适用范围以原文实验为准。

items.title_en: Beyond Binary Classification: Multiclass Machine Learning for Diabetes and Prediabetes Risk Prediction Using NHANES
items.title_zh: 超越二分类：基于 NHANES 的糖尿病与糖尿病前期多分类机器学习风险预测
items.abstract_en: Detecting diabetes risk early is important for preventing disease progression. Most existing machine learning approaches focus on binary classification, which limits their ability to capture intermediate risk states such as prediabetes. We develop a supervised learning framework to classify adults as normal, prediabetic, or diabetic using National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey data. The framework uses routinely collected demographic, clinical, and lifestyle variables from 15,356 adults, with glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) used only to define labels and excluded from input features to prevent leakage. We compare conventional machine learning and transformer-based models and examine two binary formulations: normal versus prediabetes, and normal versus combined prediabetes and diabetes. Models are evaluated on a held-out test set using precision, sensitivity, specificity, and F1 score. In the multiclass setting, performance is broadly consistent across models, with accuracy up to 0.72 and macro-averaged F1 of 0.70. Prediabetes remains the most challenging class, with F1 scores of 0.54 to 0.56 for conventional models and 0.53 to 0.55 for transformers, reflecting its overlap with both neighboring states. When the task is reduced to normal versus prediabetes, F1 scores rise modestly to 0.62 to 0.64. A more substantial improvement is observed under a broader screening formulation combining prediabetes and diabetes, with F1 scores of 0.73 to 0.74 across all models. These findings suggest that feature overlap along the biological continuum between normal and diabetic states contributes more to the difficulty of prediabetes detection than model architecture. Multiclass prediction provides a more clinically informative representation of metabolic risk progression but highlights a trade-off between clinically meaningful stratification and predictive accuracy.
items.abstract_zh: 早期识别糖尿病风险对阻止疾病进展十分重要。现有机器学习方法多集中于二分类，难以刻画糖尿病前期这类中间风险状态。我们构建了一个监督学习框架，利用美国国家健康与营养调查（NHANES）数据将成人分为正常、糖尿病前期与糖尿病三类。该框架使用 15,356 名成人的常规人口学、临床与生活方式变量，糖化血红蛋白（HbA1c）仅用于定义标签并从输入特征中剔除，以避免信息泄漏。我们比较了传统机器学习与基于 Transformer 的模型，并考察两种二分类设定：正常 vs 糖尿病前期，以及正常 vs 糖尿病前期与糖尿病合并。模型在独立测试集上用精确率、敏感度、特异度与 F1 分数评估。多分类设定下各模型表现大体接近，准确率最高 0.72，宏平均 F1 为 0.70。糖尿病前期仍是最难的类别，传统模型 F1 为 0.54~0.56，Transformer 为 0.53~0.55，反映其与相邻状态存在重叠。当任务简化为正常 vs 糖尿病前期时，F1 小幅升至 0.62~0.64；在将糖尿病前期与糖尿病合并的广谱筛查设定下提升更明显，所有模型 F1 达 0.73~0.74。这些结果表明，正常与糖尿病状态在生物学连续谱上的特征重叠，比模型结构更能解释糖尿病前期检测的困难。多分类预测能更贴近临床地刻画代谢风险进展，但也凸显……
items.highlight_zh: 糖尿病前期最难识别，瓶颈是特征重叠而非模型
items.digest_zh:
① 研究问题：早发现糖尿病风险很关键，但多数机器学习模型只做“有病/没病”的二分类，忽略了糖尿病前期这一可干预的中间状态。
② 方法：作者用美国 NHANES 中 15,356 名成人的常规人口学、临床与生活方式变量作为输入，标签由糖化血红蛋白（HbA1c）定义；关键细节是 HbA1c 被刻意排除在特征之外，防止“用答案预测答案”的信息泄漏。模型方面比较了传统机器学习与 Transformer，并另设两种二分类任务作对照，用精确率、敏感度、特异度、F1 评估。
③ 结果：三分类下各模型差距不大，最好准确率 0.72、宏平均 F1 0.70；糖尿病前期最难，F1 仅约 0.53~0.56。简化为“正常 vs 前期”时 F1 升到 0.62~0.64；把前期与糖尿病合并成“异常 vs 正常”的筛查任务，F1 可达 0.73~0.74。
④ 意义：说明难点主要来自正常、前期、糖尿病本就是一段连续谱上的特征重叠，而非模型不够强；三分类更贴近临床对代谢风险进展的刻画，但也提示糖尿病前期的自动识别仍有实质挑战。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。

items.title_en: SO-Arena: Benchmarking the Capability Spectrum and Reliability of System One Models
items.title_zh: SO-Arena：面向 System One 模型的能力谱系与决策可靠性基准评测
items.abstract_en: System One models promise fast, general-purpose decision-making without lengthy token generation. However, understanding their capability spectrum and decision reliability requires more than aggregate performance on current benchmarks. Existing evaluations often provide limited insight into the breadth of model capabilities and the reliability of their decisions. We introduce SO-Arena, a benchmark characterizing the capability spectrum and decision reliability of System One models across 11 domains and five capability families. For the capability spectrum, SO-Arena offers evidence-grounded evaluation through reliable sources and manual verification of reference labels against model-visible inputs; fine-grained capability assessment through domain-specific difficulty criteria; and realistic interactive evaluation, where models iteratively execute actions in sandboxes. Reasoning-intensive tasks further enable system one-two comparison. Beyond accuracy, SO-Arena assesses decision reliability through two complementary measures: decision stability under controlled option-set changes and missing-answer recognition when no valid option is available. Evaluations across 21 models reveal that the benefits of scaling and additional reasoning vary substantially across domains. More importantly, strong overall performance does not necessarily imply reliable decision-making: the best-performing System One model ranks only seventh in reliability. Together, these findings highlight the need to characterize capability spectrum and decision reliability as complementary dimensions, providing a systematic view of the strengths and limitations of System One models.
items.abstract_zh: System One 类模型有望无需冗长的 token 生成即可实现快速、通用的决策。然而，要理解其能力谱系与决策可靠性，仅靠现有基准上的总体性能远远不够。现有评测往往难以揭示模型能力的广度与决策的可靠性。我们提出 SO-Arena，一个覆盖 11 个领域、五类能力族、用于刻画 System One 模型能力谱系与决策可靠性的基准。在能力谱系方面，SO-Arena 通过可靠来源与人工核验（对照模型可见输入）提供有证据支撑的评测，通过领域特定的难度准则实现细粒度能力评估，并提供模型在沙箱中迭代执行动作的真实交互式评测；推理密集型任务还支持 System One 与 System Two 的对比。除准确率外，SO-Arena 通过两项互补指标评估决策可靠性：受控选项集变化下的决策稳定性，以及无有效选项时的缺失答案识别能力。对 21 个模型的评测显示，规模扩展与额外推理带来的收益在不同领域差异显著；更重要的是，总体性能强并不意味着决策可靠：表现最好的 System One 模型在可靠性上仅排名第七。这些发现表明应将能力谱系与决策可靠性作为互补维度加以刻画，从而系统性地认识 System One 模型的优势与局限。
items.highlight_zh: 总体得分最高的 System One 模型在决策可靠性上仅排第七。
items.digest_zh:
【研究了什么问题】近年出现一类被称作「System One」的模型，主打不经过长篇推理、直接快速给出决策。但业界评测通常只报告一个总分，看不出模型到底会做什么、不会做什么，也看不出它给出的答案稳不稳定、靠不靠谱。
【用了什么方法】作者构建了 SO-Arena 基准，覆盖 11 个领域、五类能力。它有三点设计：一是「有据可查」——参考标签来自可靠来源并由人工核验，且只依据模型实际能看到的输入；二是「分难度细评」——每个领域都有专门的难度标准，而不是笼统打一个分；三是「真交互」——模型要在沙箱环境中一步步执行动作，而不只是答选择题。推理密集型任务还允许把 System One 与 System Two（慢思考）模型放在一起比较。除准确率外，还专门测两种可靠性：改变选项集合后答案是否稳定，以及在没有正确选项时模型能否识别「无答案」。
【有什么结果】评测了 21 个模型。结果显示，单纯扩大规模或增加推理步数带来的收益因领域而异，差异很大；更关键的是，总分高不等于决策可靠——综合表现最好的 System One 模型在可靠性排名上只排第七。
【为何重要】这说明「能力广度」和「决策可靠性」是两个不能互相替代的维度。若只看排行榜总分就部署这类模型，可能在高风险场景中遇到答案摇摆、硬选错误选项等问题。该基准为系统性评估这类快速决策模型提供了框架。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。

items.title_en: EgoX: Egocentric Cross-Embodiment Manipulation with Embodiment Dreaming
items.title_zh: EgoX：结合具身梦境的第一人称跨具身操作
items.abstract_en: Generalist manipulation policies can benefit from the complementary experience of humans, real robots, and simulated agents. However, differences in morphology, sensing, and control interfaces make it difficult to learn effectively from their combined demonstrations. We introduce EgoX, an egocentric cross-embodiment learning framework that organizes heterogeneous demonstrations through semantically corresponding observation and action modalities. EgoX pretrains a Modularized Cross-Embodiment Transformer with Embodiment Dreaming (MXT+) on this mixture and fine-tunes it on target-embodiment demonstrations. Within each embodiment, MXT+ assigns a dedicated tokenizer to each observation modality and a dedicated expert to each action modality, with a Transformer trunk shared across embodiments. A training-only embodiment-dreaming objective predicts latent representations of future visual and proprioceptive states, encouraging the shared trunk to model each embodiment's dynamics. Across 13 task-embodiment pairs spanning five tasks and six robot embodiments, including five physical robots and one simulated humanoid, cross-embodiment pretraining raises MXT+'s average normalized task progress from 0.63 to 0.80 over training from scratch. The gains are particularly pronounced under out-of-distribution conditions, where average task progress increases from 0.53 to 0.77. Ablations demonstrate the benefits of broader pretraining mixtures, modular interfaces, and embodiment dreaming, with dreaming producing more similar latent geometry across embodiments. Project page: egox-dream.github.io.
items.abstract_zh: 通用操作策略可利用人类、真实机器人与仿真智能体的互补经验，但形态、感知与控制差异阻碍混合演示学习。EgoX 是第一人称跨具身框架，按语义对应的观测与动作模态组织异构演示，先预训练带具身梦境的模块化跨具身 Transformer（MXT+），再在目标具身微调。MXT+ 为各观测模态配专用 tokenizer、各动作模态配专用专家，共享 Transformer 主干；训练时用梦境目标预测未来视觉与本体状态潜表示。13 个任务-具身组合（5 任务、6 种具身）上，预训练将平均归一化任务进度从 0.63 提至 0.80，分布外从 0.53 提至 0.77；消融验证各组件有效。
items.highlight_zh: 跨具身预训练结合具身梦境显著提升操作策略泛化
items.digest_zh:
1）研究问题：机器人操作策略可以从人类、真实机器人和仿真智能体的演示中共同学习，但不同具身的形态、传感器和控制方式差异很大，直接混合数据往往难以奏效。
2）方法：EgoX 用第一人称视角组织跨具身数据，把不同来源的观测和动作按语义对应起来。模型 MXT+ 采用模块化设计：每种观测模态有专用 tokenizer，每种动作模态有专用专家，所有具身共享一个 Transformer 主干。训练时还加入“具身梦境”目标，让模型预测未来视觉和本体状态的潜表示，相当于在 latent 空间里预演各具身的动力学。
3）结果：在覆盖 5 个任务、6 种机器人具身（含 5 个真实机器人和 1 个仿真人形）的 13 个任务-具身组合上，跨具身预训练把平均归一化任务进度从 0.63 提到 0.80；在分布外条件下从 0.53 提到 0.77。消融实验证明更广的预训练混合、模块化接口和具身梦境都有帮助，且梦境让不同具身的潜空间几何更接近。
4）意义：该工作说明，只要合理组织异构演示并让共享主干理解各具身动力学，就能把人类、真实机器人和仿真数据转化为可迁移的操作能力，尤其改善分布外泛化。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: Open Vision Banana: A Fully Open Recipe for Generative Visual Perception
items.title_zh: Open Vision Banana：面向生成式视觉感知的完全开放配方
items.abstract_en: Recent work suggests that pretrained image generators encode real-world understanding beyond image synthesis. Vision Banana exploits this by framing vision tasks as conditional image editing. However, its data, weights, code, and implementation details are not public. We present Open Vision Banana (OVB), a fully open and reproducible recipe for converting pretrained generators into unified multi-task perception systems. Our analyses identify the design choices that matter most for generalization, including color encoding, prompt design, parameter adaptation, and task balancing. These choices interact, so individually helpful choices can hurt when combined with others. Starting from 4B and 9B parameter open-weight base models and using 2.1M-3.8M training pairs from public datasets, OVB surpasses Vision Banana's reported Cityscapes zero-shot performance (73.9 vs. 69.9 mIoU) and rivals state-of-the-art affine-invariant depth estimators. Its non-zero-shot variants come within five points of Vision Banana on referring and reasoning segmentation but remain further behind on instance segmentation. All models largely retain the base model's image-editing abilities. With legend ensembling, we introduce a test-time scaling method for generator-based perception. It segments an image under several class-color legends and fuses the results by majority vote, correcting unstable color-class bindings and improving mIoU by up to 8.7 points on Cityscapes and 15.0 points on COCO-Object without retraining. We release the dataset construction and processing pipeline, the training and evaluation code, as well as the final, intermediate, and ablation checkpoints. Project website: https://openvisionbanana.github.io
items.abstract_zh: 近期工作表明，预训练图像生成器编码了超越图像合成的现实世界理解。Vision Banana 通过将视觉任务表述为条件图像编辑来利用这一点。然而，其数据、权重、代码和实现细节未公开。我们提出 Open Vision Banana（OVB），一个完全开放且可复现的配方，用于将预训练生成器转换为统一的多任务感知系统。我们的分析识别出对泛化最关键的设计选择，包括颜色编码、提示设计、参数适配和任务平衡。这些选择相互影响，因此单独有益的选择在与其他选择结合时可能有害。从 4B 和 9B 参数的开源权重基础模型出发，并使用来自公开数据集的 2.1M–3.8M 训练对，OVB 超过了 Vision Banana 报告的 Cityscapes 零样本性能（73.9 对 69.9 mIoU），并与最先进的仿射不变深度估计器相当。其非零样本变体在指代分割和推理分割上距 Vision Banana 五分之差，但在实例分割上仍落后较多。所有模型在很大程度上保留了基础模型的图像编辑能力。借助图例集成，我们引入一种用于基于生成器的感知的测试时扩展方法。它在若干类别-颜色图例下分割图像，并通过多数投票融合结果，纠正不稳定的颜色-类别绑定，且在无需重新训练的情况下，在 Cityscapes 上将 mIoU 提升最多 8.7 分，在 COCO-Object 上提升最多 15.0 分。我们发布数据集构建与处理流程、训练与评估代码，以及最终、中间和消融检查点。项目网站：https://openvisionbanana.github.io

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为检测与跟踪，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对目标尺度、遮挡与实时延迟；公开数据集成绩不能直接等同实际场景效果。

items.title_en: Neuronal Aralar/AGC1 deficiency impairs social behavior through dopaminergic and redox dysfunction and is rescued by β-hydroxybutyrate
items.title_zh: 神经元 Aralar/AGC1 缺陷通过多巴胺能和氧化还原功能障碍损害社会行为，并可被 β-羟基丁酸挽救
items.abstract_en: Background: Pathogenic variants in SLC25A12/AGC1 (Aralar) have been linked to autism spectrum disorder (ASD), yet the mechanisms connecting neuronal metabolic dysfunction to altered social behavior remain poorly understood. Aralar is a key component of the malate-aspartate shuttle, supporting neuronal oxidative metabolism and lactate utilization. Here, we investigated the consequences of postnatal neuronal Aralar deletion and the therapeutic potential of {beta}-hydroxybutyrate (BHB). Methods: We generated neuron-specific Aralar knockout mice (Neu Aralar-KO) using CamKII-Cre, producing efficient recombination in cortex, hippocampus, and striatum. Behavioral, transcriptomic, neurochemical, morphometric, histological, and biochemical analyses were performed in adult mice. The effects of systemic BHB administration were assessed using behavioral, metabolic, oxidative stress, and transcriptomic endpoints. Results: Despite a 55-65% reduction of Aralar expression in forebrain regions, Neu Aralar-KO mice displayed normal growth, survival, brain structure, and myelination. Unexpectedly, loss of neuronal Aralar did not impair spatial memory, episodic memory, or reversal learning. In contrast, Neu Aralar-KO mice exhibited hyperactivity and a marked deficit in sociability, revealing an ASD-relevant behavioral phenotype. Morphological analysis showed significant remodeling of striatal dendritic spines without changes in spine density. Transcriptomic profiling identified 433 differentially expressed genes, the vast majority being upregulated, with enrichment of pathways related to neuropeptide signaling, synaptic transmission, membrane excitability, and behavior. Notably, genes involved in dopamine (DA) and glutamate handling, synaptic connectivity, neuromodulatory signaling, and ASD-associated pathways were strongly induced. Neurochemical analyses revealed preserved glutamate and GABA levels but reduced striatal DA content accompanied by an increased DOPAC/DA ratio, indicating enhanced DA degradation. DAergic neurons of the ventral tegmental area (VTA) showed minimal recombination, suggesting that DA dysfunction arises through non-cell-autonomous mechanisms. Consistent with increased DA oxidative catabolism, Neu Aralar-KO striata displayed elevated lipid peroxidation, induction of glutathione-related pathways, upregulation of antioxidant genes, and astrocyte activation. Remarkably, BHB treatment restored sociability, normalized striatal metabolic alterations, reduced oxidative stress, and abolished genotype-dependent neurochemical abnormalities. Transcriptomic analyses further revealed that Aralar deficiency recapitulates a substantial fraction of the fasting/BHB-induced epigenetic transcriptional program. Conclusions: Postnatal neuronal Aralar deficiency uncouples social behavior from cognitive performance and drives ASD-like phenotypes through a mechanism linking neuronal metabolic dysfunction, oxidative stress, glial activation, and impaired DAergic homeostasis. The rescue of behavioral, metabolic, and redox abnormalities by BHB identifies restoration of metabolic homeostasis as a major therapeutic mechanism and highlights metabolic interventions as promising strategies for AGC1 deficiency and ASD-associated disorders involving neuronal metabolic dysfunction.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：SLC25A12/AGC1（Aralar）的致病性变异与自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）相关，但连接神经元代谢功能障碍与社交行为改变的机制仍知之甚少。Aralar 是苹果酸-天冬氨酸穿梭的关键组分，支持神经元氧化代谢和乳酸利用。在此，我们研究了出生后神经元 Aralar 缺失的后果以及 β-羟基丁酸（BHB）的治疗潜力。方法：我们使用 CamKII-Cre 构建了神经元特异性 Aralar 敲除小鼠（Neu Aralar-KO），在皮层、海马和纹状体中产生高效重组。在成年小鼠中进行了行为、转录组、神经化学、形态计量、组织学和生化分析。使用行为、代谢、氧化应激和转录组终点评估了系统性 BHB 给药的效果。结果：尽管前脑区域 Aralar 表达降低 55–65%，Neu Aralar-KO 小鼠表现出正常的生长、存活、脑结构和髓鞘化。出乎意料的是，神经元 Aralar 缺失并未损害空间记忆、情景记忆或逆转学习。相反，Neu Aralar-KO 小鼠表现出多动和社交性显著缺陷，揭示出与 ASD 相关的行为表型。形态学分析显示纹状体树突棘显著重塑，而棘密度没有变化。转录组分析识别出 433 个差异表达基因，绝大多数上调，并富集与神经肽信号传导、突触传递、膜兴奋性和行为相关的通路。值得注意的是，参与多巴胺（DA）和谷氨酸处理、突触连接、神经调质信号传导以及 ASD 相关通路的基因被强烈诱导。神经化学分析显示谷氨酸和 GABA 水平保持不变，但纹状体 DA 含量降低，伴随 DOPAC/DA 比值升高，表明 DA 降解增强。腹侧被盖区（VTA）的 DA 能神经元显示出极少重组，提示 DA 功能障碍通过非细胞自主机制产生。与 DA 氧化分解代谢增加一致，Neu Aralar-KO 纹状体表现出脂质过氧化升高、谷胱甘肽相关通路诱导、抗氧化基因上调和星形胶质细胞活化。值得注意的是，BHB 治疗恢复了社交性，使纹状体代谢改变正常化，降低了氧化应激，并消除了基因型依赖的神经化学异常。转录组分析进一步揭示，Aralar 缺陷重现了禁食/BHB 诱导的表观遗传转录程序的相当一部分。结论：出生后神经元 Aralar 缺陷使社会行为与认知表现解偶联，并通过连接神经元代谢功能障碍、氧化应激、胶质激活和 DA 能稳态受损的机制驱动 ASD 样表型。BHB 对行为、代谢和氧化还原异常的挽救将代谢稳态的恢复确定为一种主要治疗机制，并突出代谢干预作为 AGC1 缺陷和涉及神经元代谢功能障碍的 ASD 相关疾病的有前景策略。

items.title_en: Ultracompact and Nonvolatile On-chip Switch Based on DBS and PSO Algorithms
items.title_zh: 基于 DBS 和 PSO 算法的超紧凑非易失性片上开关
items.abstract_en: A 1x2 photonic switch based on silicon-on-insulator (SOI)-Sb2Se3 hybrid platform is inverse-designed using direct binary search (DBS) and particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithms. The nonvolatile on-chip switch is designed to consist of minimum switchable phase-change units and operates based on the en-masse switching of all Sb2Se3 cells from crystalline to amorphous and vice-versa. The device has a small footprint of only 6.3umx31um. At the wavelength of 1550nm, it exhibits an insertion loss of less than 0.96dB, and its crosstalk is measured to be less than -12dB within the three-dimensional (3D) finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) simulations.
items.abstract_zh: 基于绝缘体上硅（SOI）-Sb2Se3 混合平台的 1×2 光子开关，采用直接二进制搜索（DBS）和粒子群优化（PSO）算法进行逆向设计。该非易失性片上开关被设计为由最少数量的可切换相变单元组成，并基于所有 Sb2Se3 单元从晶态到非晶态以及反之的集体切换工作。该器件占地面积仅为 6.3 μm × 31 μm。在 1550 nm 波长下，其插入损耗小于 0.96 dB，并且在三维（3D）有限差分时域（FDTD）仿真中，其串扰测量值小于 -12 dB。

items.title_en: Asymmetric Multimodal Learning with Decomposed JEPAs
items.title_zh: 基于分解式 JEPA 的非对称多模态学习
items.abstract_en: Cross-modal alignment is the standard objective for building multimodal representations. We show that alignment as a \emph{sole} objective is lossy wherever modalities are informationally asymmetric---where neither can express what the other carries. Visual question answering is an obvious case: a question is a selective relational operator probing a dense visual field whose fine-grained features no query recovers, so what alignment preserves is not what the task requires. We prove an \textbf{Alignment Redundancy Bound}: alignment-only Dirichlet energy minimization retains at most the redundant information atom $\Red(Z; X_1, X_2)$, annihilating private modality-specific structure $\Unq(Z; X_m)$ and cross-modal synergy $\Syn(Z; X_1, X_2)$. We introduce \textbf{Decomposed JEPA (D-JEPA)}, which factorizes latents into an aligned shared core and private modality-specific fibers. The shared core retains most of the structure alignment targets; the private fibers recover what alignment discards, via contextual masked prediction and asymmetric cross-subspace independence. Under information asymmetry, alignment-only training undergoes catastrophic semantic collapse on compositional reasoning benchmarks, surviving only on binary queries. D-JEPA averts this collapse, substantially improving downstream accuracy over both alignment-only and alignment-with-reconstruction baselines, and restoring a positive multimodal synergy gap in place of the baseline's inverted gap. Information-theoretic audits confirm that D-JEPA recovers most of the mutual information available from a frozen backbone, and causal fiber-swap interventions demonstrate that the recovered information is causally localized in the private fibers.
items.abstract_zh: 跨模态对齐是构建多模态表示的标准目标。我们表明，当模态在信息上不对称时——即任一模态都无法表达另一模态所携带的信息时——对齐作为唯一目标是有损的。视觉问答是一个明显案例：问题是一个选择性关系算子，探测密集视觉场，而该视觉场的细粒度特征无法被任何查询恢复，因此对齐所保留的并非任务所需。我们证明了一个对齐冗余界：仅对齐的 Dirichlet 能量最小化至多保留冗余信息原子 Red(Z; X1, X2)，消除私有模态特定结构 Unq(Z; Xm) 和跨模态协同 Syn(Z; X1, X2)。我们引入分解式 JEPA（D-JEPA），将潜在变量分解为对齐的共享核心和私有的模态特定纤维。共享核心保留对齐目标的大部分结构；私有纤维通过上下文掩码预测和非对称跨子空间独立性恢复对齐所丢弃的内容。在信息不对称下，仅对齐训练在组合推理基准上经历灾难性语义崩溃，仅在二元查询上幸存。D-JEPA 避免了这种崩溃，相较仅对齐和带重建的对齐基线大幅提高下游准确率，并恢复正的多模态协同差距，以替代基线的倒置差距。信息论审计确认，D-JEPA 恢复了冻结骨干网络可获得的绝大部分互信息，因果纤维交换干预表明所恢复的信息因果性地定位于私有纤维中。

items.title_en: Learning When Diffusion Language Models Should Regenerate
items.title_zh: 学习扩散语言模型何时应重新生成
items.abstract_en: Remasking allows diffusion language models to revisit generated text, but effective correction requires knowing when and what to revise. Our diagnosis on Sudoku reveals two gaps. Hidden states contain error information that token confidence does not reliably expose, and remasking an isolated error usually reproduces it when the surrounding context remains fixed. These findings motivate DiVR , a verifier that predicts whether a partially generated sequence will reach a correct answer. Trained on the final correctness of the model's own trajectories, DiVR decides when to regenerate a block and which alternative to retain, while the generator itself stays unchanged. On five reasoning benchmarks with LLaDA-8B-Base, DiVR raises the average accuracy of the fine-tuned generator from 35.3\% to 43.4\% at $1.9$-$3.5\times$ the cost of greedy decoding, above search baselines that use $3.8$-$7.4\times$. It also complements post-training such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, and generalizes to other generators, including Dream.
items.abstract_zh: 重掩码使扩散语言模型能够重新审视已生成文本，但有效纠正需要知道何时以及修订什么。我们在数独上的诊断揭示两个差距。隐藏状态包含令牌置信度无法可靠暴露的错误信息，并且在周围上下文保持固定时，重掩码一个孤立错误通常会重现该错误。这些发现促成 DiVR，一种预测部分生成序列是否会达到正确答案的验证器。DiVR 在模型自身轨迹的最终正确性上训练，决定何时重新生成一个块以及保留哪个替代项，而生成器本身保持不变。在 LLaDA-8B-Base 的五个推理基准上，DiVR 将微调生成器的平均准确率从 35.3% 提高到 43.4%，成本为贪婪解码的 1.9–3.5 倍，高于使用 3.8–7.4 倍成本的搜索基线。它还与监督微调和强化学习等后训练互补，并泛化到其他生成器，包括 Dream。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: AgriSense: Vision-Language Decision Support and Robotic Intervention in a Virtual Greenhouse Copy title
items.title_zh: AgriSense：虚拟温室中的视觉—语言决策支持与机器人干预
items.abstract_en: Autonomous greenhouse management increasingly requires robotic systems that integrate perception, navigation, environmental regulation, and plant-level intervention. This paper presents AgriSense, a framework combining an Isaac Sim virtual greenhouse, a quadruped mobile manipulator, RGB and LiDAR-inertial sensing, environmental control, and supervised vision-language decision support. Frozen DINOv2 and BERT encoders, together with structured environmental inputs, support joint prediction of twelve environmental references, a target zone, and an intervention flag. Checkpoint replay reproduces 41/43 zone decisions. Across five seeds on a source-grouped test set, the full, image-removed, and language-removed configurations each achieve 43/44 correct zone decisions, providing no evidence of incremental multimodal zone-accuracy improvement. The full model achieves mean absolute errors of 0.249 degrees C for temperature, 2.030 percentage points for humidity, and 0.997 percentage points for soil moisture. Sensor-only inputs match full-model zone accuracy, while language-only inputs achieve 68.64%. External real-image benchmarks reveal distribution-shift limitations. Five offline Point-LIO routes yield rigidly aligned trajectory errors of 5.22-17.32 mm. Of 40 virtual-arm targets, 32 satisfy geometric acceptance criteria and eight are rejected at boundaries. Six long-horizon climate cases and fault protocols characterize integration limits. Navigation and integrated treatment rely on simulator-state inputs; physical greenhouse performance and agronomic treatment efficacy remain unvalidated. The contribution is an evaluated decision-support and robotic-intervention framework for a virtual greenhouse.
items.abstract_zh: 自主温室管理日益需要集感知、导航、环境调控与植株级干预于一体的机器人系统。本文提出 AgriSense 框架，整合 Isaac Sim 虚拟温室、四足移动操作机器人、RGB 与 LiDAR-惯性传感、环境控制以及有监督的视觉—语言决策支持。冻结的 DINOv2 与 BERT 编码器结合结构化环境输入，联合预测 12 项环境参考值、一个目标区域和一个干预标志。检查点回放可复现 43 个区域决策中的 41 个。在按来源分组的测试集上以五个随机种子运行，完整配置、去除图像配置与去除语言配置各自均取得 44 个区域决策中 43 个正确，未发现多模态带来区域准确率增量提升的证据。完整模型的平均绝对误差为温度 0.249 摄氏度、湿度 2.030 个百分点、土壤湿度 0.997 个百分点。仅传感器输入即可达到与完整模型相同的区域准确率，而仅语言输入为 68.64%。外部真实图像基准暴露出分布偏移带来的局限。五条离线 Point-LIO 路径的刚性对齐轨迹误差为 5.22–17.32 毫米。40 个虚拟机械臂目标中有 32 个满足几何验收准则，8 个在边界处被拒绝。六个长时序气候案例与故障协议刻画了系统的集成边界。导航与集成处理依赖仿真器状态输入；物理温室中的表现与农艺处理效果尚未验证。本文的贡献是一个经过评估的、面向虚拟温室的决策支持与机器人干预框架。
items.highlight_zh: 虚拟温室机器人框架完成决策与干预验证，但多模态未带来增益，实机效果待验证。
items.digest_zh:
【研究了什么问题】温室自动化需要机器人同时会「看」（感知）、会「走」（导航）、会「调环境」（温湿度、土壤水分调控），还要能对单株植物做处理。这类系统做起来容易、验证起来难。作者提出的问题是：能否在虚拟环境中搭起一整套可评估的流程，并诚实地测出它的能力与边界。
【用了什么方法】AgriSense 在 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 中搭建虚拟温室，配一个四足移动操作机器人，传感器包括 RGB 相机和 LiDAR-惯性组合；后端用冻结的 DINOv2（图像）与 BERT（语言）编码器，再拼接结构化环境数据，同时输出三类结果：12 项环境参考值、一个目标区域、一个「是否需要干预」的标志。导航部分用 Point-LIO 做里程计。
【有什么结果】决策方面，回放测试中 43 个区域决策能复现 41 个；在五个随机种子、按来源分组的测试集上，完整模型、去掉图像、去掉语言三种配置都做到 44 个中 43 个正确——也就是说，多模态并没有带来区域判断的准确率增益，只用传感器就能达到同样水平，只用语言则降到 68.64%。环境数值预测的平均绝对误差为温度 0.249 摄氏度、湿度 2.03 个百分点、土壤湿度约 1 个百分点。导航方面，五条离线路径的刚性对齐误差在 5.22–17.32 毫米之间。机械臂 40 个目标中 32 个通过几何验收，8 个卡在边界。此外作者发现模型在真实图像上受分布偏移影响明显。
【为何重要】这项工作的价值在于「如实报告」：它给出了一个完整可运行的虚拟温室决策与干预框架，同时明确指出多模态未必有用、导航和集成依赖仿真器内部状态，而真实温室表现与农艺效果尚未验证。这为后续研究划清了哪些结论已有证据、哪些还没有。

items.title_en: Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding
items.title_zh: 拆解多模态视觉编码
items.abstract_en: How multimodal language models should encode visual input remains up for debate. Most models use a pretrained vision encoder, while some recent recipes train the encoder from scratch with the language model or remove it entirely. Vision encoders bundle together three design choices: a visual prior from upstream pretraining, dedicated vision capacity, and pre-fusion placement of that capacity (i.e., before the multimodal backbone). Because published models also differ in data, architecture, and compute, comparing them cannot isolate the effect of each choice. We disentangle these choices via a controlled framework where we pretrain all models from scratch on common data and compare them on visual question answering and language benchmarks at matched lifetime compute. We find that the visual prior is not necessary; an encoder trained jointly from scratch is on par with a pretrained one, without a separate training stage. What matters instead is dedicated vision capacity: an encoder-free model trails on visual understanding even when its backbone is enlarged by the encoder's parameter count. Yet that capacity need not precede multimodal fusion, as vision-only modules added in-fusion to early backbone layers perform comparably to a pre-fusion encoder and can lower time to first token. These results also hold across backbone sizes, when encoder pretraining is treated as free, and when starting from a pretrained language model. Overall, our findings favor dedicated vision capacity trained jointly with the backbone and placed early within it.
items.abstract_zh: 多模态语言模型应如何编码视觉输入仍存在争议。大多数模型使用预训练视觉编码器，而一些近期方案则与语言模型一起从零训练编码器，或完全移除编码器。视觉编码器将三项设计选择捆绑在一起：来自上游预训练的视觉先验、专用视觉容量，以及该容量的融合前放置位置（即位于多模态主干之前）。由于已发表模型在数据、架构和计算上也不相同，比较它们无法分离每种选择的影响。我们通过一个受控框架解耦这些选择：在共同数据上从零预训练所有模型，并在匹配生命周期计算量的条件下，在视觉问答和语言基准上比较它们。我们发现视觉先验并非必要；从零联合训练的编码器与预训练编码器表现相当，且无需单独训练阶段。真正重要的是专用视觉容量：即使将无编码器模型的主干按编码器参数量扩大，其在视觉理解上仍落后。然而，该容量不必位于多模态融合之前，因为在融合过程中加入早期主干层的纯视觉模块与融合前编码器表现相当，并可降低首 token 时间。这些结果在不同主干规模下、将编码器预训练视为免费时，以及从预训练语言模型开始时同样成立。总体而言，我们的发现支持与主干联合训练并置于主干早期层的专用视觉容量。

items.title_en: Automated Patient Identity Verification Framework for Multimodal Medical Imaging Using Deep Metric Learning and Domain Adaptation
items.title_zh: 使用深度度量学习与域适应的多模态医学影像自动患者身份验证框架
items.abstract_en: Purpose: Patient identity management is fundamental in healthcare information systems, as identification inconsistencies can compromise patient safety, data integrity, and clinical workflow efficiency. Reliable linkage of medical images acquired across different imaging modalities remains challenging because of variations in image appearance, acquisition geometry, and imaging characteristics. In this study, we developed an automated patient identity verification framework for multimodal medical imaging using deep metric learning and data-augmented domain adaptation (DADA). Methods: The proposed framework learned modality-invariant patient representations from labeled source-domain data while leveraging unlabeled target-domain data to mitigate cross-modality distribution shifts. Although patient identity annotations were available within the research dataset for evaluation purposes, target-domain labels were intentionally excluded from the DADA optimization process. Chest radiographs and computed tomography (CT) scout images obtained under routine clinical conditions were retrospectively collected and used for evaluation. Verification performance was assessed using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis, with the area under the ROC curve (AUC) used as the primary performance metric. Results: The proposed framework achieved consistently high verification performance across all evaluation conditions, with AUC values ranging from 0.9989 to 0.9999. Similarity-score distributions demonstrated distinct separation between same-patient and different-patient image pairs despite substantial differences between imaging modalities. Conclusion: These findings indicate that patient-specific anatomical representations can be preserved across heterogeneous imaging domains through metric learning and domain adaptation. The proposed framework may serve as a practical infrastructure component for patient identity management, multimodal data integration, quality assurance, and patient safety applications within healthcare information systems.
items.abstract_zh: 目的：患者身份管理是医疗信息系统的根本，因为身份识别不一致可能损害患者安全、数据完整性和临床工作流效率。由于图像外观、采集几何和成像特征的变化，可靠关联跨不同成像模态采集的医学图像仍然具有挑战性。在本研究中，我们开发了一个使用深度度量学习和数据增强域适应（DADA）的多模态医学影像自动患者身份验证框架。方法：所提框架从有标签源域数据学习模态不变的患者表示，同时利用无标签目标域数据缓解跨模态分布偏移。尽管研究数据集中存在用于评估目的的患者身份标注，但目标域标签被有意排除在 DADA 优化过程之外。回顾性收集常规临床条件下获得的胸部X线片和计算机断层扫描（CT）定位像，并用于评估。验证性能使用受试者工作特征（ROC）分析评估，以 ROC 曲线下面积（AUC）作为主要性能指标。结果：所提框架在所有评估条件下取得一致的较高验证性能，AUC 值范围为 0.9989 至 0.9999。尽管成像模态之间存在显著差异，相似性得分分布显示同患者与不同患者图像对之间具有明显分离。结论：这些发现表明，通过度量学习和域适应，患者特异性解剖表示可以跨异构成像域保留。所提框架可作为医疗信息系统中患者身份管理、多模态数据集成、质量保证和患者安全应用的实用基础设施组件。

items.title_en: Non-Convex Optimization via Quantum Tunneling Search on a Photonic Chip
items.title_zh: 基于光子芯片上量子隧穿搜索的非凸优化
items.abstract_en: Non-convex optimization plays an important role in modern machine learning since plenty of real-world problems have objective functions or constraints with non-convex properties. The non-convex nature of landscapes gives rise to numerous local minima and saddle points, dramatically hindering the ability of gradient descent-based methods to explore the landscape and obtain global optima. Here we present quantum tunneling search (QTS), an algorithm based on quantum tunneling walk and local annealing, which effectively explores the non-convex landscape by leveraging the quantum tunneling effect. In experiments, we map an objective function to the potential term of the waveguide Hamiltonian by controlling the refractive index with the femtosecond direct laser writing technique. With a proper input state, the average probability distributions on 10-micrometer-spaced 29 x 1 and 21 x 9 waveguide arrays highlight the local minima of various 1D and 2D non-convex landscapes, respectively. By further introducing the varying Hamiltonian approach, more efficient search and even the identification of the global minimum are achieved. Our work experimentally verifies that QTS is a successful and efficient non-convex optimization solver, demonstrating quantum speedups over classical stochastic gradient descent (SGD), which serves as a practical application of near-term analog quantum simulators in the field of machine learning.
items.abstract_zh: 非凸优化在现代机器学习中发挥重要作用，因为大量现实世界问题具有非凸性质的目标函数或约束。非凸景观产生众多局部极小值和鞍点，极大阻碍基于梯度下降的方法探索景观并获得全局最优。在此，我们提出量子隧穿搜索（QTS），一种基于量子隧穿行走和局部退火的算法，通过利用量子隧穿效应有效探索非凸景观。在实验中，我们通过飞秒直写激光技术控制折射率，将目标函数映射到波导哈密顿量的势项。在适当输入态下，10微米间距的29 x 1和21 x 9波导阵列上的平均概率分布分别突出各种1D和2D非凸景观的局部极小值。通过进一步引入变化哈密顿量方法，实现更高效搜索乃至全局最小值的识别。我们的工作通过实验验证QTS是一种成功且高效的非凸优化求解器，展示了相对于经典随机梯度下降（SGD）的量子加速，这为近期模拟量子模拟器在机器学习领域提供了实际应用。

items.title_en: SpaceMCP: Vision Language Model Spatial Reasoning via Model Context Protocol
items.title_zh: SpaceMCP：通过模型上下文协议进行视觉语言模型空间推理
items.abstract_en: Despite impressive advances in large language models (LLM), vision-language models (VLM) still exhibit limited spatial reasoning capabilities. Recent progress in feed-forward 3D reconstruction has enabled precise, real-time geometric understanding from visual inputs. In this work, we propose SpaceMCP, a framework that leverages these advances to introduce an MCP-style paradigm for spatial reasoning. Our approach augments a VLM with structured function calls, allowing it to query a scene graph for spatial information such as distances, object positioning, and camera properties. The scene graph is constructed in real time using feed-forward 3D reconstruction to recover metric geometry, combined with open-vocabulary segmentation to identify and localize relevant objects within the scene. Paired with the VLM's strong reasoning capabilities, the VLM is able to combine this primitive information to solve more complex spatial tasks. Without any training, SpaceMCP achieves state-of-the-art results on VSI-Bench, MMSI-Bench and VSTI-Bench, outperforming recent spatially post-trained VLMs and improving its base VLM by 15-22 points per benchmark. We argue that, given the contrast between the relatively slow progress in native VLM spatial reasoning and the rapid advances in feed-forward 3D computer vision, this paradigm offers a promising path forward for enabling robust spatial reasoning.
items.abstract_zh: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）取得令人瞩目的进展，视觉语言模型（VLM）仍表现出有限的空间推理能力。前馈3D重建的最新进展使得能够从视觉输入进行精确、实时的几何理解。在这项工作中，我们提出 SpaceMCP，一个利用这些进展引入 MCP 风格空间推理范式的框架。我们的方法通过结构化函数调用增强 VLM，使其能够查询场景图以获取距离、物体定位和相机属性等空间信息。该场景图使用前馈3D重建实时构建以恢复度量几何，并结合开放词汇分割来识别和定位场景中的相关物体。结合 VLM 强大的推理能力，VLM 能够组合这些基元信息以解决更复杂的空间任务。在无需任何训练的情况下，SpaceMCP 在 VSI-Bench、MMSI-Bench 和 VSTI-Bench 上取得最先进结果，优于近期经过空间后训练的 VLM，并在每个基准上比其基础 VLM 提升15-22个点。我们认为，鉴于原生 VLM 空间推理进展相对缓慢与前馈3D计算机视觉快速进展之间的对比，这一范式为实现稳健空间推理提供了一条有前景的路径。

items.title_en: Morphological Simplification in Alzheimer's Disease: Computational Analysis and Identification From Connected Speech
items.title_zh: 阿尔茨海默病中的形态简化：基于连续语音的计算分析与识别
items.abstract_en: Purpose: Morphology is often regarded as relatively spared in Alzheimer's disease (AD) and is rarely modeled in connected speech. This study asked which morphological features distinguish speakers with AD from healthy controls, how well morphology classifies AD compared with other linguistic levels and BERT-based models, and whether the signal exceeds transcript length and vocabulary. Method: Fifty-five automatic measures in eight families, seven of them new and theory-motivated, were computed from participant speech in the ADReSS Cookie Theft descriptions (78 AD, 78 controls) and analyzed with group comparisons, equivalence tests, SHAP, family ablation, likelihood-ratio tests, feature-selection classifiers, and BERT-based models. The automatic measures were validated manually, and models were transferred to two other corpora. Results: Nineteen of 38 measures differed between groups: speakers with AD produced fewer suffixed and inflected words, shorter verbs and nouns, and fewer present-progressive but more past-tense forms (largest effect r = -0.42), whereas errors were rare and statistically equivalent between groups. Eight measures survived adjustment for length and lexical frequency. With test-set feature selection, morphology reached a macro-F1 of 0.85, on par with syntax and above fine-tuned BERT (0.80 over five seeds); fully cross-validated selection gave 0.62. Adding morphology to BERT improved AUC (0.91 vs. 0.89) but not macro-F1. Transfer was limited, although two thirds of the effects kept their direction in mild cognitive impairment. Conclusions: AD connected speech shows morphological simplification and temporal reanchoring rather than breakdown. Morphology is more informative than its reputation suggests. Keywords: Alzheimer's disease; morphology; connected speech; ADReSS; inflection; tense and aspect; SHAP; machine learning; BERT
items.abstract_zh: 目的：形态学通常被认为在阿尔茨海默病（AD）中相对保留，且很少在连续语音中建模。本研究询问哪些形态特征区分AD说话者与健康对照，与其他语言层面和基于BERT的模型相比形态学对AD的分类效果如何，以及该信号是否超出转写长度和词汇量。方法：从ADReSS Cookie Theft描述中的参与者语音（78名AD、78名对照）计算八个类别中的55个自动测量指标，其中七个是新的且有理论依据，并使用组间比较、等价性检验、SHAP、类别消融、似然比检验、特征选择分类器和基于BERT的模型进行分析。自动测量指标经人工验证，模型被迁移到另外两个语料库。结果：38项测量中有19项在组间存在差异：AD说话者产生更少的带后缀和屈折变化的词、更短的动词和名词，以及更少的现在进行时但更多的过去时形式（最大效应 r = -0.42），而错误很少且在组间统计上等价。八项测量在对长度和词汇频率进行调整后仍然成立。在测试集特征选择下，形态学达到0.85的macro-F1，与句法相当，并高于微调BERT（五个随机种子上的0.80）；完全交叉验证的选择得到0.62。将形态学加入BERT提高了AUC（0.91 vs. 0.89），但未提高macro-F1。迁移有限，尽管三分之二的效应在轻度认知障碍中保持了方向。结论：AD连续语音表现出形态简化和时间重新锚定，而非崩溃。形态学比其声誉所暗示的更具信息量。关键词：阿尔茨海默病；形态学；连续语音；ADReSS；屈折；时态与体；SHAP；机器学习；BERT

items.title_en: NSDL: Neuro-Symbolic Division of Labor for Multi-Robot Task Planning
items.title_zh: NSDL：用于多机器人任务规划的神经符号分工
items.abstract_en: Planning for a heterogeneous robot team from a scene image and an instruction involves two kinds of decisions. Some must be judged from the scene: which goals are already met, how the task splits, and which robot does what. Others follow from these and can be computed: prerequisite actions, handoffs between robots, and timing. We argue that each kind should go to the component suited to it: a small vision-language model learns the first, and a deterministic solver computes the second. In NSDL (Neuro-Symbolic Division of Labor), the trained model writes its judgments as a plan sketch, which lists the goals that still need action and the intended steps in order, each with a robot. The solver expands the sketch into an executable joint plan. The model calls two tools, a detector for evidence and the solver, and is trained with the solver in the loop. We evaluate on the public VIKI-L2 benchmark and on LOCUS-Bench, a new benchmark that grades the two kinds of difficulty separately. NSDL outperforms end-to-end planners and formalize-then-plan baselines on both benchmarks and with three backbones from 3B to 8B; the 7B model reaches 97.0% out-of-distribution accuracy on VIKI-L2. Ordering and scheduling errors nearly disappear once the solver writes the structure; the remaining failures are misjudged states, and most goals the model misses are ones it never lists. Code, model weights, and LOCUS-Bench are publicly available at https://github.com/Xincheng-Tan/NSDL.
items.abstract_zh: 根据场景图像和指令为异构机器人团队进行规划涉及两类决策。一些必须从场景判断：哪些目标已经满足、任务如何拆分，以及哪个机器人做什么。另一些由此推导并可以计算：前置动作、机器人之间的交接以及时序。我们认为每一类都应交给适合它的组件：一个小型视觉语言模型学习第一类，确定性求解器计算第二类。在 NSDL（Neuro-Symbolic Division of Labor）中，训练后的模型将其判断写为计划草图，列出仍需动作的目标以及按顺序的预期步骤，每一步均指定一个机器人。求解器将草图扩展为可执行的联合计划。该模型调用两个工具，一个用于证据的检测器和该求解器，并在求解器在环的情况下训练。我们在公开的 VIKI-L2 基准和 LOCUS-Bench 上评估，后者是一个分别对两类难度进行评分的新基准。NSDL 在两个基准上以及使用从3B到8B的三个骨干时均优于端到端规划器和先形式化再规划的基线；7B模型在 VIKI-L2 上达到97.0%的分布外准确率。一旦求解器写出结构，排序和调度错误几乎消失；剩余失败是状态误判，而模型漏掉的大多数目标是它从未列出的目标。代码、模型权重和 LOCUS-Bench 已在 https://github.com/Xincheng-Tan/NSDL 公开可用。

items.title_en: UniSpark: Exploring Hybrid Attention for Multimodal Understanding and Generation
items.title_zh: UniSpark：探索用于多模态理解与生成的混合注意力
items.abstract_en: We present UniSpark-9B, a unified multimodal model that investigates hybrid attention for visual understanding and generation. Built on a Mixture-of-Transformer-Experts backbone with approximately 9B parameters in each branch, UniSpark combines full attention for explicit token interactions with GatedDeltaNet linear attention for compact context propagation. Autoregressive text prediction and visual flow matching jointly support visual question answering, text-to-image generation, instruction-guided editing, and interleaved text-image prediction. In interleaved generation, noisy visual targets are isolated from subsequent predictions, while clean visual representations provide context for later outputs. A blockwise protocol enforces this distinction through attention masks in full-attention layers and recurrent-state retention rules in linear-attention layers. The selected training sources contain 159.7M generation samples, 213.4M understanding samples, and 624.8K interleaved sequences. A four-stage curriculum jointly trains multimodal understanding and visual generation, refining answer accuracy and instruction following while extending image synthesis to 2K. UniSpark scores 2470.3 on MME-S and 0.83 on GenEval. Qualitative examples further illustrate its capabilities in interleaved image generation, video synthesis, and video editing. Together, these results demonstrate that hybrid attention provides an effective backbone for unified multimodal understanding and generation.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 UniSpark-9B，一个统一多模态模型，研究用于视觉理解与生成的混合注意力。UniSpark 构建于 Mixture-of-Transformer-Experts 骨干之上，每个分支约 9B 参数，结合用于显式 token 交互的全注意力与用于紧凑上下文传播的 GatedDeltaNet 线性注意力。自回归文本预测与视觉流匹配共同支持视觉问答、文生图生成、指令引导编辑以及交错文本-图像预测。在交错生成中，噪声视觉目标与后续预测隔离，而干净视觉表示为后续输出提供上下文。一个分块协议通过全注意力层中的注意力掩码和线性注意力层中的循环状态保留规则来强制这一区分。所选训练源包含 159.7M 生成样本、213.4M 理解样本和 624.8K 交错序列。四阶段课程联合训练多模态理解与视觉生成，提升答案准确性和指令遵循，同时将图像合成扩展到 2K。UniSpark 在 MME-S 上得分 2470.3，在 GenEval 上得分 0.83。定性示例进一步展示其在交错图像生成、视频合成和视频编辑方面的能力。总体而言，这些结果表明混合注意力为统一多模态理解与生成提供了有效骨干。

items.title_en: DeepRNAi: Predicting on- and off-target siRNA activity and establishing a benchmark
items.title_zh: DeepRNAi：预测siRNA的靶内与脱靶活性并建立基准
items.abstract_en: Small interfering RNAs (siRNAs) silence target genes through RISC-mediated hybridization and cleavage, but can silence unintended transcripts and cause toxicity or complicate regulatory approval. In drug development, empirical assessment by qPCR and RNA-seq is slow, forces early candidate prioritization, and is limited by available species- and genome-appropriate cell models. While extensive empirical screening remains standard practice, there is a significant opportunity for modern AI methods to change this paradigm. We introduce DeepRNAi, a deep learning model that accurately predicts on- and off-target knockdown from siRNA and mRNA sequence. Trained on 16 million siRNA-transcript pairs from 2,031 siRNAs designed to interrogate known siRNA failure modes, and incorporating transcript context from biological foundation models, DeepRNAi is the first in silico method that approaches experimental accuracy. It generalizes across cell models, transcripts, genomes and species, and in a small study distinguishes approved therapeutics from hepatotoxic candidates. The value of DeepRNAi for prioritizing better candidates up front improving likelihood of success later in development is evidenced by a genome-wide survey of 24.4 million siRNAs targeting 7,946 genes, which indicates that 90.1% of the 100 most potent siRNAs have at least some off-target concerns. To support the community, we are publishing a training and benchmark dataset containing 1.84 million siRNA-transcript pairs from 240 siRNAs.
items.abstract_zh: 小干扰RNA（siRNA）通过RISC介导的杂交与切割沉默靶基因，但也可能沉默非预期转录本，导致毒性或使监管审批复杂化。在药物开发中，通过qPCR和RNA-seq进行经验性评估速度慢、迫使早期候选优先级排序，并受限于可用的物种和基因组适配细胞模型。尽管大规模经验筛选仍是标准做法，现代AI方法仍有显著机会改变这一范式。我们提出DeepRNAi，一种深度学习模型，可从siRNA和mRNA序列准确预测靶内和脱靶敲低。DeepRNAi在来自2,031条siRNA的1600万对siRNA-转录本上训练（这些siRNA旨在探究已知的siRNA失效模式），并纳入来自生物基础模型的转录本上下文，是首个接近实验准确度的计算机模拟方法。它可跨细胞模型、转录本、基因组和物种泛化，并在一项小型研究中区分已批准疗法与肝毒性候选物。一项全基因组调查覆盖靶向7,946个基因的2440万条siRNA，表明100条最强效siRNA中有90.1%至少存在一定的脱靶担忧，这证明了DeepRNAi在前期优先选择更优候选、从而提高后期开发成功可能性的价值。为支持社区，我们发布一个训练与基准数据集，包含来自240条siRNA的184万对siRNA-转录本。
