items.title_en: Multimodal Semantic Communication using Shared and Unique Representation Decomposition
items.title_zh: 基于共享与独有表示分解的多模态语义通信
items.abstract_en: Semantic communication (SemCom) has emerged as a promising paradigm for bandwidth-constrained mobile and vehicular networks. This paper proposes a unified representation learning framework for multimodal SemCom (MSC), which encodes heterogeneous data into a compact semantic space for efficient transmission and source recovery. The framework addresses the multimodal semantic representation gap, which arises when at least one modality contains semantic information that cannot be fully inferred from the other. To preserve this information for reconstruction, the framework decomposes each representation into shared and modality-specific components. We formulate a mutual information objective for source reconstruction, cross-modal alignment of the shared components, and decoupling of the shared and modality-specific components. To enhance transmission efficiency, we introduce a shared knowledge base implemented as a compact codebook of semantic vectors learned during training. The shared components are transmitted digitally as codebook indices, while the modality-specific components are sent in analog form. We apply knowledge distillation during training, using a pretrained vision foundation model to guide the learning of quantized shared features. On image--text pairs over additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) and Extended Vehicular A (EVA) channels, the proposed framework improves image reconstruction over conventional separate source-channel coding (SSCC) and representative multimodal and unimodal SemCom systems. Further evaluations show gradual degradation under channel-estimation mismatch, complementary effects of alignment, decoupling, and knowledge distillation on the shared representation, and alignment of shared features across modalities with separation of the modality-specific features.
items.abstract_zh: 语义通信（SemCom）已成为带宽受限的移动与车载网络中一种有前景的范式。本文提出一个面向多模态语义通信（MSC）的统一表示学习框架，将异构数据编码到紧凑语义空间，以实现高效传输和信源恢复。该框架应对多模态语义表示鸿沟，即当至少一个模态包含无法从另一模态完全推断的语义信息时出现的问题。为在重建中保留该信息，框架将每个表示分解为共享分量和模态特有分量。我们为信源重建、共享分量的跨模态对齐以及共享与模态特有分量的解耦构建了互信息目标。为提升传输效率，我们引入共享知识库，其实现为训练期间学到的语义向量紧凑码本。共享分量以码本索引形式数字传输，而模态特有分量以模拟形式发送。训练中采用知识蒸馏，使用预训练视觉基础模型指导量化共享特征的学习。在加性白高斯噪声（AWGN）和扩展车辆A（EVA）信道上的图像-文本对实验中，所提框架在图像重建上优于传统分离信源信道编码（SSCC）以及代表性的多模态和单模态SemCom系统。进一步评估表明，在信道估计失配下性能逐渐退化，对齐、解耦和知识蒸馏对共享表示具有互补作用，并且共享特征跨模态对齐且模态特有特征分离。

items.title_en: Disentangling Spurious Correlations: How IRM Handles Diverse Shortcuts in Text Classification
items.title_zh: 解耦虚假相关：IRM如何处理文本分类中的多样捷径
items.abstract_en: In NLP, models trained via Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM) often exploit spurious correlations, such as dialectal markers, at the expense of robust linguistic features, thereby degrading their out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization. Invariant Risk Minimization (IRM) aims to suppress such shortcuts by identifying predictive relationships that remain stable across environments, but its practical utility for NLP remains debated. We use a causality-driven framework to evaluate IRM under three shortcut-generating mechanisms: label-generated features, confounding, and selection bias. Our results show that IRM successfully rejects shortcuts across the evaluated causal and anti-causal structures, including under limited environmental variation and increasing label noise. We then extend our analysis beyond controlled synthetic artifacts to two less constrained settings: gender-profession associations in Bias in Bios and semantically loaded actor-name shortcuts in ActorCorr. These experiments show that invariant learning can mitigate more realistic textual shortcuts, while semantically meaningful features require careful calibration of the invariance penalty.
items.abstract_zh: 在NLP中，通过经验风险最小化（ERM）训练的模型常利用虚假相关（如方言标记）而牺牲稳健的语言特征，从而降低其分布外（OOD）泛化能力。不变风险最小化（IRM）旨在通过识别在环境间保持稳定的预测关系来抑制此类捷径，但其在NLP中的实际效用仍有争议。我们使用因果驱动的框架，在三种产生捷径的机制下评估IRM：标签生成特征、混杂和选择偏差。结果表明，在所评估的因果与反因果结构中，IRM成功拒绝捷径，包括在有限环境变化和标签噪声增加的情况下。随后我们将分析扩展到受控合成伪影之外的两个约束较少的设置：Bias in Bios中的性别-职业关联，以及ActorCorr中语义负载的演员姓名捷径。这些实验表明，不变学习可以缓解更现实的文本捷径，而语义有意义的特征需要谨慎校准不变性惩罚。

items.title_en: Differentiable Filtering for Inertial Odometry
items.title_zh: 用于惯性里程计的可微滤波
items.abstract_en: Accurate inertial odometry is critical for autonomous systems but suffers from unbounded drift caused by the integration of sensor noise and biases. In approaches such as TLIO, neural pseudo-measurements are trained independently of their downstream filter. This paper introduces Differentiable Filtering for Inertial Odometry (DFIO), a learning framework that embeds the update stages of an error-state Kalman filter directly into a computational graph. Following standalone pre-training, DFIO jointly optimizes the displacement and covariance output heads using posterior-position supervision through differentiable measurement updates. The proposed system is validated on public pedestrian motion datasets featuring both calibrated and uncalibrated inertial measurements. Experimental results on a pedestrian dataset demonstrate that DFIO reduces mean absolute and one-second relative translation errors by 13.2% and 39.6% relative to the TLIO baseline, and by 7.7% and 17.4% relative to its pre-trained counterpart. Furthermore, evaluations on uncalibrated smartphone inertial data indicate that the proposed method effectively mitigates translational drift and maintains trajectory alignment under highly noisy sensor conditions. Source code will be made publicly available.
items.abstract_zh: 准确的惯性里程计对自主系统至关重要，但会因传感器噪声和偏置的积分而产生无界漂移。在TLIO等方法中，神经伪测量与下游滤波器独立训练。本文提出用于惯性里程计的可微滤波（DFIO），一种将误差状态卡尔曼滤波器的更新阶段直接嵌入计算图的学习框架。在独立预训练之后，DFIO通过可微测量更新，使用后验位置监督联合优化位移和协方差输出头。所提系统在包含校准和未校准惯性测量的公开行人运动数据集上验证。在行人数据集上的实验结果表明，相对于TLIO基线，DFIO将平均绝对平移误差和一秒相对平移误差分别降低13.2%和39.6%，相对于其预训练对应模型分别降低7.7%和17.4%。此外，在未校准智能手机惯性数据上的评估表明，所提方法有效缓解平移漂移，并在高噪声传感器条件下保持轨迹对齐。源代码将公开。

items.title_en: Lightweight Deep Learning Framework for Astrocyte-Centric 3D Reconstruction across Normal and Stress-associated Ultrastructural States
items.title_zh: 用于正常与应激相关超微结构状态的以星形胶质细胞为中心的轻量级深度学习三维重建框架
items.abstract_en: The morphology of astrocytes is closely associated with their ability to support and modulate neural circuit functions; however, its reconstruction from volume electron microscopy (vEM) data remains labor-intensive and computationally resource-intensive, placing substantial barriers on its broader adoption and scalability despite the high spatial resolution of vEM. We present AstroSeg-vEM, a lightweight, astrocyte-centric framework for morphology-preserving astrocyte segmentation, 3D reconstruction, and quantitative morphological analysis in vEM images. AstroSeg-vEM combines transformer-based 2D segmentation with dedicated post-processing methods and operates directly on high-resolution EM sections, making it well suited to anisotropic vEM data and downstream proofreading workflows while preserving the full in-plane resolution of the original EM data. Across four mouse hippocampal datasets representing normal and morphologically defined stress-associated astrocyte ultrastructural states, AstroSeg-vEM demonstrates robust performance and generalization, achieving average Dice and weighted Dice values of 0.92 and 0.95, respectively, on a held-out test dataset. Its lightweight architecture enables efficient, high-fidelity reconstruction on consumer-grade hardware, providing a scalable and accessible platform for large-scale astrocyte ultrastructure analysis and future astrocyte-neuron interaction studies.
items.abstract_zh: 星形胶质细胞的形态与其支持和调节神经回路功能的能力密切相关；然而，从体电子显微镜（vEM）数据中重建其形态仍然费时费力且计算资源密集，尽管vEM具有高空间分辨率，这对其更广泛的采用和可扩展性构成了重大障碍。我们提出了AstroSeg-vEM，一个轻量级、以星形胶质细胞为中心的框架，用于vEM图像中保持形态的星形胶质细胞分割、三维重建和定量形态分析。AstroSeg-vEM将基于Transformer的二维分割与专门的后处理方法相结合，并直接在高分辨率EM切片上运行，使其非常适合各向异性vEM数据和下游校对工作流，同时保留原始EM数据的完整面内分辨率。在代表正常和形态学定义的应激相关星形胶质细胞超微结构状态的四个小鼠海马数据集上，AstroSeg-vEM表现出稳健的性能和泛化能力，在留出测试数据集上分别达到0.92和0.95的平均Dice和加权Dice值。其轻量级架构可在消费级硬件上实现高效、高保真重建，为大规模星形胶质细胞超微结构分析和未来的星形胶质细胞-神经元相互作用研究提供了可扩展且易获取的平台。

items.title_en: Optimization principles, revisited
items.title_zh: 优化原理再审视
items.abstract_en: The brain solves a wide range of problems, and some of these solutions are very good indeed. It is an old idea that, in some cases, these solutions may be as good as possible given the relevant constraints. If this is true we can promote this notion of optimization to a principle from which aspects of function and mechanism can be derived, ideally with no free parameters. Optimization principles are powerful and have had many successes, but they remain controversial. We start with a reminder of a classic example---diffraction limited optics in insect eyes---and then a summary of why you should worry about optimization as a more general principle. Next we turn to recent progress on the theory of optimal motion estimation in fly vision, and finally summarize recent results on the landscape for optimization, arguing that (contrary to widely held intuitions) optimal performance need not require the underlying mechanisms to have finely tuned parameters. I hope to convince you that this is a moment to take optimization seriously as the basis for theories of neural coding and computation. This is based on a rather informal lecture at the summer school LASCON X in Sao Paulo, and I have tried to preserve that tone here; pointers are given to more detailed and technical discussions.
items.abstract_zh: 大脑解决了广泛的问题，其中一些解决方案确实非常好。一个古老的观点是，在某些情况下，给定相关约束，这些解决方案可能已经尽可能好。如果这是真的，我们可以将这种优化概念提升为一条原理，从中可以推导出功能和机制的不同方面，理想情况下没有自由参数。优化原理很强大，并取得了许多成功，但它们仍然存在争议。我们首先回顾一个经典例子——昆虫眼睛中的衍射极限光学——然后总结为什么你应该将优化作为一个更普遍的原理而担忧。接下来，我们转向果蝇视觉中最优运动估计理论的最新进展，最后总结关于优化景观的最新结果，论证（与广泛持有的直觉相反）最优性能不一定要求底层机制具有精细调整的参数。我希望说服你，现在正是认真对待优化作为神经编码和计算理论基础的时机。本文基于在圣保罗LASCON X暑期学校的一次相当非正式的讲座，我试图在这里保持那种语气；并给出了更详细和技术性讨论的指引。

items.title_en: Traces of Vacuum Squeezing: A Superconducting Transmission-Line Analogue of Cosmological Particle Creation
items.title_zh: 真空压缩的痕迹：宇宙学粒子创生的超导传输线类比
items.abstract_en: Particle creation in time-dependent quantum fields is a central phenomenon in early-universe cosmology, yet it remains experimentally inaccessible in its original context. We show theoretically that superconducting circuits based on a waveguide-like transmission line loaded with dc-SQUIDs can provide a direct analogue of a scalar field in a radiation-dominated Friedmann--Robertson--Walker universe in conformal time. The mode equation of the circuit reduces to the Weber equation, the same equation governing cosmological particle creation in a radiation-dominated background, admitting an exact solution in terms of parabolic cylinder functions and an exponentially suppressed particle spectrum. We analyse the conditions under which the analogy holds, which require a compromise between the duration of the pulse, the uniformity of the modulation and the symmetry of the SQUIDs, and show that dissipation does not erase the cosmological signal. We use the anomalous moment of each mode as a witness of the Bogoliubov mixing: it vanishes for any thermal state and survives dissipation, and, together with the photon number, it certifies squeezing, and with the purity of the state, it identifies whether the pairs created from the vacuum dominate.
items.abstract_zh: 含时量子场中的粒子创生是早期宇宙学中的一个核心现象，但其原始背景在实验上仍无法触及。我们从理论上证明，基于加载直流SQUID的类波导传输线的超导电路，可以在共形时间中直接模拟辐射主导的Friedmann–Robertson–Walker宇宙中的标量场。该电路的模式方程约化为Weber方程，这与辐射主导背景下支配宇宙学粒子创生的方程相同，并允许以抛物柱函数表示的精确解和指数抑制的粒子谱。我们分析了该类比成立的条件，这些条件需要在脉冲持续时间、调制均匀性和SQUID对称性之间取得折衷，并表明耗散不会抹除宇宙学信号。我们使用每个模式的异常矩作为Bogoliubov混合的见证：它对于任何热态都消失，并且在耗散下仍然存在；与光子数一起，它证明压缩，与态的纯度一起，它识别从真空产生的粒子对是否占主导。

items.title_en: Personalized Affective Perception via Continual Learning in Human-Agent Negotiation
items.title_zh: 人-智能体谈判中基于持续学习的个性化情感感知
items.abstract_en: Self-interested intelligent agents that negotiate with humans should interpret nonverbal expressions and adapt their behavior accordingly. However, generic facial-affect models degrade across individuals and contexts, creating a generalization gap. We introduce an affect-adaptive negotiation strategy that incorporates Continual Learning with Imagination for Facial Expression Recognition (CLIFER) to personalize valence-arousal perception in real time. Differential feedback converts changes in valence-arousal direction and intensity into adjustments of the agent's target utility. An asynchronous architecture updates CLIFER in the background during live interaction. In a counterbalanced within-subject study in which 66 participants negotiated with a humanoid robot, the CL-enabled agent achieved significantly higher individual utility and elicited higher participant concession rates than the FaceChannel baseline. The CL condition yielded significantly higher mean arousal estimates, alongside a broader output range. Participant utility and Nash distance did not change significantly between conditions. These outcomes support the practical value of coupling continual affective personalization with differential feedback for real-time negotiation.
items.abstract_zh: 与人类谈判的自利智能体应解释非言语表达并相应调整其行为。然而，通用面部情感模型在不同个体和情境下会退化，从而产生泛化差距。我们引入一种情感自适应谈判策略，该策略结合了用于面部表情识别的持续学习与想象（CLIFER），以实时个性化效价-唤醒感知。差分反馈将效价-唤醒方向和强度的变化转换为对智能体目标效用的调整。异步架构在实时交互期间在后台更新CLIFER。在一项66名参与者与类人机器人谈判的平衡被试内研究中，启用持续学习（CL）的智能体比FaceChannel基线获得了显著更高的个体效用，并引发了更高的参与者让步率。CL条件产生了显著更高的平均唤醒估计，同时输出范围更广。参与者效用和Nash距离在不同条件之间没有显著变化。这些结果支持将持续情感个性化与差分反馈相结合用于实时谈判的实用价值。

items.title_en: Auditing AI peer reviewers: a benchmark on real scientific papers
items.title_zh: 审计AI同行评审员：基于真实科学论文的基准
items.abstract_en: LLM-based peer review is now used at production scale, but its evaluation remains limited. We introduce a benchmark that injects objective, localisable errors of four types (general issues, mathematics, numerics, citations) at three severity levels into real papers and measures each reviewer's detection rate by error type and severity, together with its false-positive rate on clean copies. We also present Skepthical, a multi-agent reviewer that verifies citation-backed claims by retrieving the cited papers, mathematics with computer algebra, and numerical claims with executed code. We apply the benchmark to two corpora of 15 recent arXiv preprints each, one in astrophysics and one in machine learning (ML), injecting a total of 357 errors, and evaluate twelve reviewer systems: six single-LLM reviewers, two Claude Code configurations, three publicly available reviewers, and Skepthical. The choice of model has the largest impact on detection rate: given the same prompt, three frontier LLMs differ by about 50 percentage points in total detection on both corpora. Tools and scaffolding help when they contribute what the model cannot supply on its own. In particular, on astrophysics, Claude Code improves on a single Claude call in mathematics and numerics detection, and enforced citation retrieval gives Skepthical the highest citation error detection rate of all systems by a large margin. This citation lead, however, is not observed on ML, where the models appear to know the literature better and Skepthical's citation detection rate is statistically indistinguishable from that of the best single LLM. False-positive rates are below 10% for most systems, but vary with prompt, model, and scaffolding, with mathematics flags the main source of false positives. The evaluation pipeline, the injected errors, and the adjudication logs are released as a benchmark.
items.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的同行评审现已在生产规模上使用，但其评估仍然有限。我们引入一个基准，将四种类型（一般问题、数学、数值、引用）的客观、可定位错误以三个严重程度注入真实论文，并按错误类型和严重程度测量每个评审员的检测率，以及其在干净副本上的假阳性率。我们还提出了Skepthical，一个多智能体评审员，通过检索被引论文来验证有引用支持的主张，使用计算机代数验证数学，并使用执行的代码验证数值主张。我们将该基准应用于两个语料库，每个语料库包含15篇近期arXiv预印本，一个在天体物理学，一个在机器学习（ML），共注入357个错误，并评估十二个评审系统：六个单LLM评审员、两个Claude Code配置、三个公开可用的评审员以及Skepthical。模型的选择对检测率影响最大：在相同提示下，三个前沿LLM在两个语料库上的总检测率相差约50个百分点。工具和脚手架在能提供模型自身无法提供的内容时会有帮助。特别是在天体物理学上，Claude Code在数学和数值检测方面优于单次Claude调用，而强制引用检索使Skepthical在所有系统中以很大优势获得最高的引用错误检测率。然而，这一引用优势在ML上未被观察到，在那里模型似乎更了解文献，Skepthical的引用检测率与最佳单LLM在统计上无法区分。大多数系统的假阳性率低于10%，但随提示、模型和脚手架而变化，数学标记是假阳性的主要来源。评估流水线、注入的错误和裁定日志作为基准发布。

items.title_en: Large Language Model Explainability for Planning Lunar Rover Trajectories under Uncertainty
items.title_zh: 不确定性下月球车轨迹规划的大语言模型可解释性
items.abstract_en: Planning planetary rover trajectories under probabilistic uncertainty is a multi-objective optimization problem that science teams currently iteratively solve and verify by hand. This process becomes impractical when timelines and constraints frequently shift throughout the mission planning phase. Sampling-based planners such as Monte Carlo tree search can speed up this process, but their outputs do not preserve traceability to the science objectives that justify each plan, which the science team needs to verify. We propose an interactive assistant based on a large language model (LLM) that can explain planner trajectories using domain vocabulary and re-run the planner under user-specified conditions to compare alternatives. Previous work has used LLMs inside planner decision-making loops, but we explore using them for post-planning explanation, where they are more likely to be trusted since they do not directly influence planner decisions. Our framework pairs a simulator inspired by the NASA Volatiles Investigating Polar Exploration Rover (VIPER) mission with a ReAct queryable interface that calls curated action tools and retrieval functions. We evaluate the assistant on a query bank consisting of plan comparisons, feasibility, and lookup queries. Experiments show that 90.9% of the assistant's responses are faithful to the planner's outputs, a nearly 65% improvement over zero-shot prompting of the same LLM without tool access, demonstrating the potential for trustworthy explainability of uncertainty-aware traverses with an LLM-based system.
items.abstract_zh: 在概率不确定性下规划行星车轨迹是一个多目标优化问题，科学团队目前通过手工迭代求解和验证。当时间线和约束在整个任务规划阶段频繁变化时，这一过程变得不切实际。基于采样的规划器（如蒙特卡洛树搜索）可以加速这一过程，但其输出不能保持对证明每个规划合理的科学目标的可追溯性，而科学团队需要验证这一点。我们提出一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的交互式助手，它可以使用领域词汇解释规划器轨迹，并在用户指定条件下重新运行规划器以比较备选方案。先前的工作已在规划器决策循环内使用LLM，但我们探索将其用于规划后解释，在这种情况下它们更可能被信任，因为它们不直接影响规划器决策。我们的框架将受NASA挥发物调查极地探索车（VIPER）任务启发的模拟器与ReAct可查询接口配对，该接口调用精选的动作工具和检索函数。我们在一个由规划比较、可行性和查找查询组成的查询库上评估该助手。实验表明，助手90.9%的响应忠实于规划器的输出，比同一LLM在无工具访问条件下的零样本提示提高了近65%，展示了基于LLM的系统对不确定性感知遍历进行可信可解释性的潜力。

items.title_en: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.abstract_en: We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing an underlying continuous volumetric scene function using a sparse set of input views. Our algorithm represents a scene using a fully-connected (non-convolutional) deep network, whose input is a single continuous 5D coordinate (spatial location $(x,y,z)$ and viewing direction $(θ, φ)$) and whose output is the volume density and view-dependent emitted radiance at that spatial location. We synthesize views by querying 5D coordinates along camera rays and use classic volume rendering techniques to project the output colors and densities into an image. Because volume rendering is naturally differentiable, the only input required to optimize our representation is a set of images with known camera poses. We describe how to effectively optimize neural radiance fields to render photorealistic novel views of scenes with complicated geometry and appearance, and demonstrate results that outperform prior work on neural rendering and view synthesis. View synthesis results are best viewed as videos, so we urge readers to view our supplementary video for convincing comparisons.

items.title_zh: NeRF：将场景表示为用于视图合成的神经辐射场
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法，通过使用稀疏的输入视图集合优化底层的连续体积场景函数，在合成复杂场景的新视图方面取得了最先进的结果。我们的算法使用全连接（非卷积）深度网络表示场景，其输入是单个连续的5维坐标（空间位置$(x,y,z)$和观察方向$(θ, φ)$），输出是该空间位置处的体积密度和与视角相关的发射辐射度。我们通过沿相机光线查询5D坐标来合成视图，并使用经典体积渲染技术将输出的颜色和密度投影到图像中。由于体积渲染天然可微，优化我们的表示所需的唯一输入是一组具有已知相机位姿的图像。我们描述了如何有效优化神经辐射场，以渲染具有复杂几何形状和外观的场景的逼真新视图，并展示了优于先前神经渲染和视图合成工作的结果。视图合成结果最好以视频形式观看，因此我们敦促读者观看我们的补充视频以进行有说服力的比较。

items.title_en: Influence of the branching geometry on SPION propagation: coupling of experiment and simulation
items.title_zh: 分支几何结构对SPION传播的影响：实验与模拟的耦合
items.abstract_en: Magnetic Drug Targeting (MDT) is an emerging therapeutic concept in cancer medicine, where superparamagnetic iron oxide nanoparticles (SPIONs) are used as carriers for medication. Their magnetic properties allow for the manipulation of particle transport within the vascular structure and thus targeted delivery to the tumor site. To develop effective concepts for particle steering and accumulation, a detailed understanding of the particle--flow interaction, especially at asymmetric vascular bifurcations, is needed. Based on hierarchical scaling laws, generalized bifurcation geometries with varying degrees of asymmetry were derived and additively manufactured. The particle distribution was investigated by in situ optical measurements under different flow conditions and magnetic field configurations and compared with Lagrangian particle and Volume of Fluid Simulations (VoFS). While the particle mass partition followed the hydraulic flow split in asymmetric bifurcations, density-driven stratification dominated in the symmetric bifurcation, where one daughter branch received only a minor fraction of the particle mass at low flow rates despite carrying half of the flow. The Lagrangian model reproduced the predominantly advective propagation, whereas only the VoFS approach captured the stratification-induced asymmetry. Magnetic actuation counteracted the stratification, reversed the passive branch preference and increased particle retention. From a molecular communication perspective, bifurcation geometry, collective volume effects and magnetic actuation thus jointly determine the received particle signal at vascular bifurcations.
items.abstract_zh: 磁靶向药物递送（MDT）是癌症医学中一个新兴的治疗概念，其中超顺磁性氧化铁纳米颗粒（SPION）被用作药物载体。其磁性使得可以操纵血管结构内的颗粒输运，从而实现向肿瘤部位的靶向递送。为了开发有效的颗粒操控和积聚概念，需要详细了解颗粒-流动相互作用，尤其是在不对称血管分叉处。基于分层缩放定律，推导了具有不同不对称程度的广义分叉几何结构，并以增材制造方式制备。在不同流动条件和磁场配置下，通过原位光学测量研究了颗粒分布，并与拉格朗日颗粒模拟和流体体积模拟（VoFS）进行比较。虽然颗粒质量分配在不对称分叉中遵循水力流动分配，但密度驱动的分层在对称分叉中占主导，其中在低流速下，一个子分支尽管承载一半流量，却只接收到很小一部分颗粒质量。拉格朗日模型再现了以平流为主的传播，而只有VoFS方法捕捉到了分层诱导的不对称性。磁驱动抵消了分层，逆转了被动分支偏好并增加了颗粒滞留。从分子通信的角度来看，分叉几何结构、集体体积效应和磁驱动因此共同决定了血管分叉处接收到的颗粒信号。

items.title_en: A deployed four-city entanglement-based QKD network with real-time key delivery, benchmarked against finite-key security bounds
items.title_zh: 一个已部署的四城市基于纠缠的QKD网络，具有实时密钥交付，并以有限密钥安全界进行基准测试
items.abstract_en: Quantum key distribution (QKD) generates shared secret keys whose security rests on the laws of physics rather than on computational assumptions. We report the entanglement-based segment of the Slovak national quantum communication infrastructure, connecting four cities in western Slovakia over deployed telecommunication fiber. Polarization-entangled photons generated at a central node are passively routed by wavelength to form a trusted-node-free, fully meshed sub-network of three cities, with the fourth connected through the central node and all links operated simultaneously. We also introduce a matrix formalism for passive wavelength routing that enables the algorithmic construction of uniquely and fully connected topologies. Unlike most previous demonstrations, which estimate key rates from raw coincidences, all rates reported here are obtained after the complete post-processing chain, with keys delivered in real time via ETSI GS QKD 014. With partial non-local chromatic dispersion compensation, we obtain 13.5 bit/s over 109 km, and 4.3 bit/s over 32.1 dB of accumulated loss between two cities without a direct fiber link. Benchmarking against finite-key security bounds shows that the implemented heuristic privacy amplification can exceed the finite-key bound, and that replacing detect-and-discard with error correction would increase the finite-key rate by a factor of 4.1-6.6, and yield a positive finite-key rate on the 142.9 km link where the implemented scheme yields none.
items.abstract_zh: 量子密钥分发（QKD）生成共享秘密密钥，其安全性基于物理定律而非计算假设。我们报告了斯洛伐克国家量子通信基础设施中基于纠缠的段落，通过已部署的电信光纤连接斯洛伐克西部的四个城市。在中心节点产生的偏振纠缠光子按波长被动路由，形成一个三城市的无需可信节点的全网状子网络，第四个城市通过中心节点连接，且所有链路同时运行。我们还引入了一种用于被动波长路由的矩阵形式体系，使得能够以算法方式构造唯一且全连接的拓扑。与大多数先前演示从原始符合计数估计密钥率不同，这里报告的所有速率都是在完整后处理链之后获得的，密钥通过ETSI GS QKD 014实时交付。在部分非局域色散补偿下，我们在109 km上获得13.5 bit/s，在两个没有直接光纤链路的城市之间在32.1 dB的累积损耗下获得4.3 bit/s。针对有限密钥安全界的基准测试表明，所实现的启发式隐私放大可能超过有限密钥界，并且用纠错替代检测并丢弃会将有限密钥率提高4.1-6.6倍，并在142.9 km链路上产生正的有限密钥率，而所实现的方案在该链路上未产生任何正速率。

items.title_en: $Σ$-LeWM: Learning World Models via S-Information for Robot Control
items.title_zh: $Σ$-LeWM：通过S-信息学习世界模型用于机器人控制
items.abstract_en: World models have increasingly been applied as a model-based control method for robotics tasks such as manipulation and locomotion. While early world model architectures relied on decoders to prevent mode collapse and learn a predictable latent space, recent works on world models, such as Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture or LeWorldModel, increasingly aim to learn embeddings without a grounding decoder, utilising only a latent forward dynamics predictor and a stabilising entropy term. In this paper, we set out to demonstrate that the further introduction of two additional latent losses to LeWorldModel, a backward dynamics predictor and an inverse dynamics action predictor, enforces further structure on the latent embedding, leading to further gains in both performance and planning efficiency. These are critical properties for improving the applicability of such methods to real-time model-based control of real-world robots. We demonstrate these gains on standard world model benchmarks and two simulated robot manipulation tasks.
items.abstract_zh: 世界模型越来越多地被用作机器人任务（如操作和运动）中基于模型的控制方法。虽然早期世界模型架构依赖解码器来防止模式崩溃并学习可预测的潜在空间，但近期关于世界模型的工作，例如联合嵌入预测架构或LeWorldModel，越来越旨在学习无需基础解码器的嵌入，仅利用潜在前向动力学预测器和稳定熵项。在本文中，我们旨在证明，向LeWorldModel进一步引入两个额外的潜在损失——一个反向动力学预测器和一个逆动力学动作预测器——会对潜在嵌入施加进一步的结构，从而在性能和规划效率方面带来进一步提升。这些是提高此类方法对真实世界机器人实时基于模型控制适用性的关键属性。我们在标准世界模型基准和两个模拟机器人操作任务上展示了这些收益。

items.title_en: Human or Synthetic? What a Fixed Budget Buys for Post-Training
items.title_zh: 人类还是合成？固定预算能为后训练带来什么
items.abstract_en: Post-training of large language models typically combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with preference-based fine-tuning such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). Human-annotated and synthetically generated preference data differ substantially in per-sample cost, but prior work typically holds sample count fixed when comparing the two. In this work, we explicitly study the interplay between cost and performance by comparing the effect of post-training with human and synthetic preference data under a fixed, dollar-matched annotation budget. We train and evaluate multiple base model families across helpfulness and summarization tasks. We find that synthetic data is far more cost-efficient at low-to-moderate budgets, achieving high win rates with as little as \$200--\$400. On helpfulness, human data closes the gap only at budgets roughly two orders of magnitude larger; on summarization, it does not close the gap at any tested budget. We also find that human-annotated data varies in reliability: one widely used human preference source substantially underperforms another, and the gap persists even after standard remedies such as domain restriction and deduplication.
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型的后训练通常将监督微调（SFT）与基于偏好的微调（如直接偏好优化（DPO））相结合。人工标注和合成生成的偏好数据在每样本成本上差异很大，但先前工作通常在比较两者时固定样本数量。在这项工作中，我们通过在固定的、金额匹配的标注预算下比较使用人类和合成偏好数据进行后训练的效果，明确研究成本与性能之间的相互作用。我们在有用性和摘要任务上训练和评估多个基础模型系列。我们发现，在低至中等预算下，合成数据的成本效益要高得多，仅用200--400美元即可实现高胜率。在有用性方面，人类数据仅在预算大约高出两个数量级时才能缩小差距；在摘要方面，它在任何测试预算下都无法缩小差距。我们还发现，人工标注数据的可靠性存在差异：一个广泛使用的人类偏好来源的表现大大低于另一个，并且即使在领域限制和去重等标准补救措施之后，差距仍然存在。

items.title_en: UAV-Flow++: A Unified Suite for Benchmarking and Learning Language-Guided UAV Flight
items.title_zh: UAV-Flow++：用于基准测试和学习语言引导无人机飞行的统一套件
items.abstract_en: Language-guided UAV navigation has largely focused on long-horizon route planning, leaving short-range, object-relative flight maneuvers underexplored. To address this gap, we formulate Flying-on-a-Word (Flow), a task requiring a UAV to convert concise natural-language instruction, egocentric visual observation, and current state dynamics into continuous flight actions. Flow encompasses both primitive motion commands and complex object-interactive behaviors, assessing motion intent comprehension and spatial context grounding. To enable policy learning and closed-loop evaluation, we introduce UAV-Flow, a comprehensive dataset comprising 30,692 expert-piloted real-world trajectories across eight distinct motion categories, alongside 10,109 simulation trajectories in the UAV-Flow-Sim environment equipped with task-specific completion criteria. Furthermore, we develop FlowVLA, which undergoes imitation pretraining on mixed real-sim demonstrations and online post-training via Tail-Aware GRPO (TGRPO). By leveraging group reward distributions, TGRPO effectively reinforces high-reward action sequences. Evaluated on 273 held-out UAV-Flow-Sim episodes, pretrained FlowVLA achieves a mean success rate of 75.58%, outperforming the strongest baseline by 6.72 percentage points, which TGRPO post-training further elevates to 93.16% with superior sample efficiency. Physical UAV experiments demonstrate robust execution of object-relative commands in both indoor and outdoor real-world scenes. Together, Flow establishes a novel benchmark and learning framework for language-conditioned flight maneuvers.
items.abstract_zh: 语言引导的无人机导航在很大程度上集中于长时程路线规划，而短距离、相对于物体的飞行机动仍未得到充分探索。为弥补这一空白，我们形式化了Flying-on-a-Word（Flow）任务，该任务要求无人机将简洁的自然语言指令、自我中心视觉观察和当前状态动力学转换为连续飞行动作。Flow涵盖基本运动命令和复杂的物体交互行为，评估运动意图理解和空间上下文 grounding。为支持策略学习和闭环评估，我们引入了UAV-Flow，这是一个综合数据集，包含八个不同运动类别中的30,692条专家驾驶的真实世界轨迹，以及配备任务特定完成标准的UAV-Flow-Sim环境中的10,109条模拟轨迹。此外，我们开发了FlowVLA，其在混合真实-模拟演示上进行模仿预训练，并通过Tail-Aware GRPO（TGRPO）进行在线后训练。通过利用组奖励分布，TGRPO有效强化高奖励动作序列。在273个留出的UAV-Flow-Sim回合上评估，预训练的FlowVLA实现了75.58%的平均成功率，比最强基线高出6.72个百分点，而TGRPO后训练进一步将其提升至93.16%，且样本效率更优。物理无人机实验展示了在室内和室外真实世界场景中对物体相对命令的稳健执行。总之，Flow为语言条件飞行机动建立了一个新的基准和学习框架。

items.title_en: Duo: A Reciprocal World Model for Full-Duplex Interaction
items.title_zh: Duo：一种用于全双工交互的互惠世界模型
items.abstract_en: In this report, we introduce the Reciprocal World Model (RWM) and present Duo v1, a full-duplex world model that continuously perceives audiovisual inputs while responding to users in real time. The RWM treats intelligence and physical reality as equally fundamental to what constitutes a world. Existing world models largely focus on simulating the latter, leaving reasoning and decision-making as external controls rather than intrinsic parts of the world itself. In RWM, we identify two equally fundamental capabilities: Intent, which provides the cognition underlying world interactions, and Realization, which generates coherent audio-visual behavior. To realize this formulation, Duo v1 introduces three key technical designs: (1) Leveraging autoregressive modeling for continuous interaction reasoning and participation decisions, rather than restricting it to instruction understanding for diffusion models. (2) Constructing chunk-specific conditions and synchronize tokens across Intent and Realization on a unified timeline. Module-specific attention masks enforce causal dependencies both within and across chunks, preventing access to future inputs. (3) Mitigating distribution shift in both modules through dual rollout distillation, training on autoregressively generated Intent tokens and synthesized audiovisual histories from Realization. Both modules continuously perceive real-time audio, video, and text, enabling full-duplex interaction with spontaneous conversations and interruptions. Beyond conversation, users can share real objects, reshape virtual scenes, guide assistants, or play audiovisual games without mouse or keyboard controls. The release of Duo v1 makes our first step, with the next version coming soon. We look forward to broader exploration of this emerging field.
items.abstract_zh: 在本报告中，我们介绍互惠世界模型（Reciprocal World Model, RWM），并提出 Duo v1，一个持续感知视听输入并实时响应用户的全双工世界模型。RWM 将智能与物理现实视为构成世界的同等基本要素。现有世界模型主要侧重于模拟后者，将推理与决策留作外部控制，而非世界本身的内在组成部分。在 RWM 中，我们识别出两项同等基本的能力：Intent，其为世界交互提供底层认知；以及 Realization，其生成连贯的视听行为。为实现这一表述，Duo v1 引入三项关键技术设计：（1）利用自回归建模进行连续交互推理和参与决策，而非将其限制为扩散模型的指令理解。（2）构建块特定条件，并在统一时间线上同步 Intent 与 Realization 之间的 token。模块特定的注意力掩码在块内和跨块强制因果依赖，防止访问未来输入。（3）通过双 rollout 蒸馏缓解两个模块中的分布偏移，在自回归生成的 Intent token 和由 Realization 合成的视听历史之上进行训练。两个模块持续感知实时音频、视频和文本，从而实现具有自发对话与打断的全双工交互。除对话之外，用户无需鼠标或键盘控制即可共享真实物体、重塑虚拟场景、引导助手或玩视听游戏。Duo v1 的发布迈出了我们的第一步，下一版本即将推出。我们期待对这一新兴领域进行更广泛的探索。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: ProTEUS: A mutation-resolved world model for closed-loop protein evolution
items.title_zh: ProTEUS：一种用于闭环蛋白质进化的突变分辨世界模型
items.abstract_en: Protein engineering requires navigating rugged fitness landscapes, where small sequence changes can produce large functional differences, but experimental screening can only sample a small fraction of sequence space. Thus, a central challenge is to efficiently traverse the large combinatorial space of mutations in silico. We introduce ProTEUS, a mutation-resolved world model for closed-loop protein evolution. Pretrained on deep mutational scanning assays, ProTEUS learns a joint representation of sequence, evolutionary, and structural information using MutationFormer, a mutation-biased attention architecture. Variants are represented as states in this joint latent space, and mutations define actions whose functional consequences are predicted. To support exploration of many mutants, we developed a fast, physics-constrained all-atom predictor that utilizes explicit geometric constraint enforcement to achieve >10 fold increase in speed than AlphaFold3 with guaranteed physical validity. Lastly, ProTEUS refines its prediction and understanding of protein activity through closed loop experimental feedback to guide evolution toward a desired phenotype. ProTEUS surpasses established models in both zero-shot and supervised fine-tuning mutation prediction tasks. We experimentally demonstrate its utility in two closed-loop multi-objective engineering campaigns on aldehyde dehydrogenase and levansucrase, yielding variants with >10 fold higher activity than wild type. ProTEUS provides a world-model framework that connects virtual evaluation of mutational outcomes with experimental learning for efficient protein evolution.
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质工程需要在崎岖的适应度景观中导航，其中微小的序列变化可能产生巨大的功能差异，但实验筛选只能采样序列空间的一小部分。因此，一个核心挑战是在计算机中高效遍历庞大的突变组合空间。我们提出 ProTEUS，一种用于闭环蛋白质进化的突变分辨世界模型。ProTEUS 在深度突变扫描实验数据上预训练，使用 MutationFormer（一种突变偏置注意力架构）学习序列、进化和结构信息的联合表示。变体在该联合潜空间中表示为状态，突变定义动作，并预测其功能后果。为支持对大量突变体的探索，我们开发了一种快速、物理约束的全原子预测器，其利用显式几何约束执行，在保证物理有效性的同时实现比 AlphaFold3 超过 10 倍的速度提升。最后，ProTEUS 通过闭环实验反馈来改进其对蛋白质活性的预测和理解，以引导进化朝向所需表型。ProTEUS 在零样本和监督微调突变预测任务中均超越已有模型。我们在醛脱氢酶和果聚糖蔗糖酶上的两个闭环多目标工程活动中通过实验证明了其效用，产生的变体活性比野生型高 >10 倍。ProTEUS 提供了一个世界模型框架，将突变结果的虚拟评估与实验学习连接起来，以实现高效的蛋白质进化。

items.title_en: Implementation of a 1D Gaussian-modulated CV-QKD under finite-size parameter estimation
items.title_zh: 有限码长参数估计下的一维高斯调制 CV-QKD 实现
items.abstract_en: Continuous-variable quantum key distribution (CV-QKD) is a promising technology for quantum-secure communications, offering high secret-key rates and straightforward integration with coherent optical communication systems. Conventional Gaussian-modulated CV-QKD encodes information in both optical-field quadratures, increasing requirements for state preparation, modulation, and calibration, while potentially introducing additional preparation imperfections. Unidimensional (1D) Gaussian modulation offers a simpler alternative by encoding information in only one quadrature, while the conjugate quadrature constrains the protocol's security. However, an integrated experimental 1D implementation combining independent-laser coherent reception with practical reconciliation, finite-size parameter estimation, and privacy amplification remains challenging. Here, we experimentally demonstrate a 1D Gaussian-modulated CV-QKD system over 12~km of standard single-mode fiber using a local local oscillator (LLO) architecture with independent lasers and an integrated offline classical post-processing chain. The implementation includes coherent detection, digital signal processing, information reconciliation, parameter estimation, physicality-constrained security analysis, and privacy amplification. The 1D system achieves a privacy-amplified rate of $1.421$~Mbit/s under the asymptotic security treatment and $0.364$~Mbit/s under the finite-size scenario. These results establish an experimental baseline for the performance--complexity trade-off associated with unidimensional Gaussian modulation and provide an experimental basis for developing lower-complexity CV-QKD transmitters.
items.abstract_zh: 连续变量量子密钥分发（CV-QKD）是量子安全通信的一项有前景的技术，可提供高密钥速率，并能直接与相干光通信系统集成。传统高斯调制 CV-QKD 在光场的两个正交分量中编码信息，增加了态制备、调制和校准的要求，同时可能引入额外的制备不完美性。一维（1D）高斯调制通过在仅一个正交分量中编码信息提供了一种更简单的替代方案，而共轭正交分量则约束协议的安全性。然而，将独立激光器相干接收与实际协调、有限码长参数估计和隐私放大相结合的一体化 1D 实验实现仍具挑战性。在此，我们实验演示了一个在 12~km 标准单模光纤上的 1D 高斯调制 CV-QKD 系统，采用具有独立激光器的本地本振（local local oscillator, LLO）架构和集成离线经典后处理链。该实现包括相干检测、数字信号处理、信息协商、参数估计、物理性约束安全性分析和隐私放大。该 1D 系统在渐近安全性处理下实现 $1.421$~Mbit/s 的隐私放大速率，在有限码长场景下实现 $0.364$~Mbit/s。这些结果为与一维高斯调制相关的性能—复杂度权衡建立了实验基线，并为开发更低复杂度的 CV-QKD 发射机提供了实验基础。

items.title_en: Symmetry in Time: A Representation Theory of Linear Recurrent Memory
items.title_zh: 时间中的对称性：线性循环记忆的表示理论
items.abstract_en: State space models (SSMs) are an emerging alternative to Transformers. SSMs offer linear-time inference and parallel training, but most implementations make the parallel scan efficient by making the recurrence diagonal: each channel of the hidden state is multiplied by an input-dependent real or complex number. These numbers commute, so the state records which inputs occurred but not their order. We formalize this with representation theory, which explains and fixes the state-tracking failures previously reported for SSMs. The state update defines a linear representation of the monoid of input sequences, and we show that an SSM tracks a group at every sequence length exactly when that group is a quotient of the group generated by its transition matrices. Two consequences follow. Diagonal real- and complex-valued SSMs can track only commutative groups, while the transition matrices of any SSM that can track a group must split into independent blocks over the real, complex, and quaternion numbers. We then introduce HyperSSM, which adds quaternion channels while keeping linear-time inference and parallel training. Trained only on final answers, HyperSSM solves the group tasks of recent state-tracking benchmarks exactly with at most five state numbers. This includes $S_5$ with 32 generators, where previous SSMs are at chance, and HyperSSM generalizes to sequences 25 times longer than those seen in training. Because the theory says what the transitions must encode, the learned weights of the linear recurrence can be interpreted directly. We demonstrate this by recovering the calibration of a real gyroscope, the rotations of imperfect qubit gates and the geometry of protein backbones.
items.abstract_zh: 状态空间模型（SSM）是 Transformer 的新兴替代方案。SSM 提供线性时间推理和并行训练，但大多数实现通过将循环变为对角来使并行扫描高效：隐藏状态的每个通道乘以一个依赖于输入的实数或复数。这些数可交换，因此状态记录了哪些输入发生过，但不记录其顺序。我们用表示理论将其形式化，该理论解释并修复了此前报告的 SSM 状态跟踪失败。状态更新定义了输入序列幺半群的一个线性表示，我们证明：一个 SSM 在每一序列长度上跟踪一个群，当且仅当该群是其转移矩阵所生成群的商群。由此得出两个推论。对角实值和复值 SSM 只能跟踪交换群，而任何能够跟踪一个群的 SSM 的转移矩阵必须在实数、复数和四元数上分裂为独立块。随后我们提出 HyperSSM，它加入四元数通道，同时保持线性时间推理和并行训练。仅用最终答案训练，HyperSSM 以至多五个状态数精确求解近期状态跟踪基准中的群任务。这包括具有 32 个生成元的 $S_5$，此前 SSM 在此仅处于随机水平，而 HyperSSM 可泛化到比训练中所见长 25 倍的序列。由于理论说明了转移必须编码什么，线性循环的学习权重可以直接解释。我们通过恢复真实陀螺仪的校准、不完美量子比特门的旋转以及蛋白质骨架的几何结构来证明这一点。

items.title_en: Outcome-Mass Alignment: Controlling Length-Dependent Trajectory Influence in Multi-Turn LLM Agent Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: Outcome-Mass Alignment：控制多轮 LLM 智能体强化学习中依赖长度的轨迹影响
items.abstract_en: To keep long interaction contexts tractable, stepwise group-relative training for multi-turn LLM agents materializes each source trajectory into multiple response rows and valid tokens. This expansion creates an outer-accounting problem distinct from within-trajectory credit assignment: row-based outcome statistics can count one episode outcome multiple times, while token-level reduction can assign unequal aggregate objective mass across trajectories. We term these effects outcome-statistics multiplicity and objective-mass imbalance. We introduce Outcome-Mass Alignment (OMA), a two-component method that makes both accounting choices explicit. Outcome Alignment computes outcome statistics over unique source trajectories, while Mass Alignment controls aggregate objective mass after within-trajectory aggregation of optimizer-native token objectives. Neither redesigns the base optimizer's credit assignment, importance ratios, or clipping. Across matched ALFWorld GRPO comparisons at two model scales, where failed trajectories typically expand much more than successful ones, OMA improves matched-horizon endpoint success by 7.0-9.4 percentage points. Ordinary WebShop exhibits weak or reversed expansion-outcome coupling and correspondingly mixed effects, whereas in a success-oriented WebShop setting, WebShop-SOL, OMA improves success nAUC from 0.399 to 0.511. Component ablations and GiGPO and GSPO comparisons further support component separability and cross-optimizer compatibility. These results show that trajectory expansion always defines an implicit weighting rule, but its practical effect depends on how expansion couples to outcomes and optimizer-native updates.
items.abstract_zh: 为使长交互上下文保持可处理，多轮 LLM 智能体的逐步组相对训练将每个源轨迹物化为多个响应行和有效 token。这种扩展产生了区别于轨迹内信用分配的外部核算问题：基于行的结果统计可能将一个回合结果多次计数，而 token 级归约可能在不同轨迹间分配不相等的聚合目标质量。我们将这些效应称为结果统计多重性和目标质量不平衡。我们提出结果—质量对齐（Outcome-Mass Alignment, OMA），一种双组件方法，使两种核算选择显式化。Outcome Alignment 在唯一源轨迹上计算结果统计，而 Mass Alignment 在轨迹内聚合优化器原生 token 目标之后控制聚合目标质量。二者均不重新设计基础优化器的信用分配、重要性比率或裁剪。在两个模型规模的匹配 ALFWorld GRPO 比较中，失败轨迹通常比成功轨迹扩展得多得多，OMA 将匹配视界的端点成功率提高 7.0–9.4 个百分点。普通 WebShop 表现出较弱或反向的扩展—结果耦合，并相应地产生混合效应；而在面向成功的 WebShop 设置 WebShop-SOL 中，OMA 将成功 nAUC 从 0.399 提高到 0.511。组件消融以及 GiGPO 和 GSPO 比较进一步支持组件可分离性和跨优化器兼容性。这些结果表明，轨迹扩展总是定义了一种隐式加权规则，但其实际效果取决于扩展如何与结果及优化器原生更新耦合。

items.title_en: Maximizing LLM Utility While Managing LLM Fallibility
items.title_zh: 在管理 LLM 易错性的同时最大化 LLM 效用
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can supply autonomous systems with plans, predictions, and judgments, but these contributions are sometimes wrong. This review asks how a system can maximize an LLM's utility while managing its fallibility. Our answer is to adapt the system's reliance on the LLM as evidence about the LLM's performance accumulates. Systems built from imperfect components, such as noisy sensors and faulty software, have long worked in this way, and the classical methods they use can be applied to LLM-based systems as well. A system can change its reliance on an LLM in several ways, depending on the LLM's role and on the other components in the system. Each change needs an estimate of the LLM's reliability, and the LLM's role and the kind of contribution it makes determine what to estimate. Classical methods from decision theory, estimation, and online learning then turn these estimates into reliance decisions. These decisions can reduce how often LLM errors affect the system. However, some errors matter even when they are rare. An independently verified mechanism can prevent such errors from being executed. Without one, adapting reliance using reliability estimates can still keep their risk within a bound. Studies on adapting reliance on LLMs are emerging but limited, and the reviewed comparisons suggest that adapting reliance can improve system performance.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）可为自主系统提供计划、预测和判断，但这些贡献有时是错误的。本综述探讨系统如何在管理 LLM 易错性的同时最大化其效用。我们的答案是：随着关于 LLM 性能的证据不断积累，调整系统对 LLM 的依赖。由不完美组件（如有噪声的传感器和故障软件）构建的系统长期以来一直以这种方式工作，其所使用的经典方法也可应用于基于 LLM 的系统。系统可以通过多种方式改变对 LLM 的依赖，具体取决于 LLM 的角色以及系统中的其他组件。每种改变都需要对 LLM 可靠性的估计，而 LLM 的角色及其所作贡献的种类决定了需要估计什么。来自决策理论、估计和在线学习的经典方法随后将这些估计转化为依赖决策。这些决策可以减少 LLM 错误影响系统的频率。然而，有些错误即使罕见也很重要。独立验证机制可以防止此类错误被执行。在没有该机制的情况下，使用可靠性估计调整依赖仍可将其风险保持在界限内。关于调整对 LLM 依赖的研究正在兴起但仍然有限，所综述的比较表明，调整依赖可以改善系统性能。

items.title_en: Spatiotemporal learning improves quantification of pore-space evolution and fluid displacement
items.title_zh: 时空学习提升孔隙空间演化与流体驱替的量化
items.abstract_en: Pore-space evolution and fluid displacement influence how rocks transmit and store fluids, affecting geological carbon storage, underground hydrogen storage and groundwater contaminant transport. A single time-resolved micro-CT experiment may produce tens to hundreds of three-dimensional images, and segmentation is required to quantify physical properties and run image-based simulations. Traditional methods such as thresholding perform poorly on noisy, low-contrast images and need manual adjustment per image; 3D deep learning networks segment each image without temporal information, so their errors vary between images and could be mistaken for physical change. Here we introduce a transformer-based 4D segmentation framework combining spatial and temporal information. It uses sequential images to resolve ambiguous phase assignments and separate physical change from segmentation error. The method is tested on images of mineral dissolution: it measures pore-volume growth and rock boundaries more accurately than an equivalent 3D model that ignores temporal information. It also captures the increase in permeability verified against reference segmentations and flow simulations. The advantage transfers to another dissolution sample without retraining. On two other datasets of fluid displacement, it reduces spurious changes in predicted rock and porosity fluctuations and accurately identifies filling events. Spatiotemporal segmentation turns sequences of hundreds of three-dimensional images into more reliable quantitative measurements of pore-space evolution and fluid displacement without per-image parameter adjustment to support the analysis of time-resolved CT imaging.
items.abstract_zh: 孔隙空间演化与流体驱替影响岩石如何传输和储存流体，进而影响地质碳封存、地下氢储存和地下水污染物运移。单次时间分辨 micro-CT 实验可能产生数十至数百幅三维图像，而量化物理性质并运行基于图像的模拟需要进行分割。阈值化等传统方法在噪声大、对比度低的图像上表现不佳，且每幅图像都需要手动调整；三维深度学习网络在不使用时间信息的情况下分割每幅图像，因此其误差在图像之间变化，并可能被误认为物理变化。在此，我们提出一种结合空间和时间信息的基于 transformer 的 4D 分割框架。它利用序列图像解决模糊的相分配问题，并将物理变化与分割误差分开。该方法在矿物溶解图像上进行了测试：与忽略时间信息的等效 3D 模型相比，它能更准确地测量孔隙体积增长和岩石边界。它还捕获了渗透率的增加，并已用参考分割和流动模拟加以验证。该优势无需重新训练即可迁移到另一个溶解样品。在另外两个流体驱替数据集上，它减少了预测岩石中的虚假变化和孔隙度波动，并准确识别充填事件。时空分割将数百幅三维图像的序列转化为更可靠的孔隙空间演化和流体驱替定量测量，且无需逐图像调整参数，从而支持时间分辨 CT 成像分析。

items.title_en: EvoSurv: Evolution-Aware Multimodal Survival Modeling Reveals Complementary Prognostic Signals
items.title_zh: EvoSurv：演化感知的多模态生存建模揭示互补预后信号
items.abstract_en: Accurate cancer survival prediction remains challenging due to tumor heterogeneity. Although multimodal survival models integrate clinical and molecular data, they often overlook evolutionary information encoded in genomic alterations. To address this gap, we developed eTime, a 38-dimensional evolutionary representation comprising eight feature groups that characterize clonal and subclonal mutation burden, mutational spectra, functional consequences, copy-number alterations, and anoikis-related genomic changes. We further developed EvoSurv, a multimodal survival framework integrating eTime with clinical variables and RNA expression. Across six TCGA cancer cohorts comprising 2,782 patients, EvoSurv achieved the highest mean concordance index (C-index) in all six cancers, averaging 0.663 and outperforming three state-of-the-art survival prediction methods. More importantly, we assessed whether evolutionary features provide additional prognostic information beyond clinical and transcriptomic predictors. eTime remained significantly associated with survival in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSC) and liver hepatocellular carcinoma (LIHC) after adjustment for clinical variables and RNA-derived risk scores. Feature-group analyses further revealed cancer-specific prognostic patterns. In HNSC, T>G substitutions were associated with increased mortality risk after clinical and molecular adjustment, including in HPV-negative patients, with supporting evidence from an independent CPTAC-HNSCC cohort. Overall, these findings demonstrate that eTime captures survival-associated evolutionary information and highlight its potential to provide prognostic value beyond clinical and transcriptomic predictors.
items.abstract_zh: 由于肿瘤异质性，准确的癌症生存预测仍具挑战性。尽管多模态生存模型整合了临床和分子数据，但它们常常忽略基因组改变所编码的演化信息。为填补这一空白，我们开发了 eTime，一种 38 维演化表征，包含八个特征组，用于刻画克隆和亚克隆突变负荷、突变谱、功能后果、拷贝数改变以及与失巢凋亡相关的基因组变化。我们进一步开发了 EvoSurv，一种将 eTime 与临床变量和 RNA 表达整合的多模态生存框架。在涵盖 2,782 名患者的六个 TCGA 癌症队列中，EvoSurv 在所有六种癌症中均取得最高的平均一致性指数（C-index），平均为 0.663，并优于三种最先进的生存预测方法。更重要的是，我们评估了演化特征是否在临床和转录组预测因子之外提供额外预后信息。在调整临床变量和 RNA 衍生风险评分后，eTime 在头颈部鳞状细胞癌（HNSC）和肝细胞癌（LIHC）中仍与生存显著相关。特征组分析进一步揭示了癌症特异性预后模式。在 HNSC 中，经临床和分子调整后，T>G 替换与死亡风险增加相关，包括在 HPV 阴性患者中，并有来自独立 CPTAC-HNSCC 队列的支持证据。总体而言，这些发现表明 eTime 捕获了与生存相关的演化信息，并突显其在临床和转录组预测因子之外提供预后价值的潜力。

items.title_en: Programming Quantum Circuit Parameters with Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 使用大语言模型进行量子电路参数编程
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have recently demonstrated the ability to generate parameters for variational quantum circuits without conventional optimization. However, the conditions under which this approach is effective remain unclear. Here, we investigate a frozen, general-purpose LLM that generates complete circuit parameter vectors from symbolic circuit and Hamiltonian descriptions, with optional iterative energy feedback. We evaluate the approach on general random Hamiltonians, structured parent Hamiltonians, and molecular systems. For general Hamiltonians, LLM-generated parameters exhibit larger energy errors than conventional Adam optimization, while additional feedback generally provides limited improvement. In contrast, for structured Hamiltonians, the LLM can generate promising low-energy parameter configurations, suggesting that identifiable physical and mathematical structure facilitates parameter inference. We also show that direct LLM predictions of minimum energies can violate the Hamiltonian spectral lower bound, whereas generated circuit parameters allow independent evaluation of physically realizable energy expectation values. Finally, we investigate blind circuit interpretation and find that the LLM can predict measurement outcomes even when it fails to identify the underlying quantum algorithm. These findings highlight the role of problem structure, the limitations of iterative LLM optimization, and the importance of independently verifiable predictions in quantum parameter programming.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）最近已证明能够在没有传统优化的情况下为变分量子电路生成参数。然而，这种方法在何种条件下有效仍不清楚。在此，我们研究一个冻结的通用 LLM，它从符号电路和哈密顿量描述生成完整的电路参数向量，并可选择迭代能量反馈。我们在一般随机哈密顿量、结构化母哈密顿量和分子系统上评估该方法。对于一般哈密顿量，LLM 生成的参数相比传统 Adam 优化表现出更大的能量误差，而额外反馈通常仅带来有限改进。相反，对于结构化哈密顿量，LLM 能够生成有希望的低能参数配置，这表明可识别的物理和数学结构有助于参数推断。我们还表明，LLM 直接预测最低能量可能违反哈密顿量谱下界，而生成的电路参数允许对物理可实现的能量期望值进行独立评估。最后，我们研究盲电路解释，发现即使 LLM 未能识别底层量子算法，它也能预测测量结果。这些发现突显了问题结构的作用、迭代 LLM 优化的局限性，以及独立可验证预测在量子参数编程中的重要性。

items.title_en: An Invariant Neural-Network Eddy-Viscosity Closure with Iterative Solver Coupling for Molten Salt Fast Reactor Thermal-Hydraulics
items.title_zh: 用于熔盐快堆热工水力的不变神经网络涡黏性闭合及迭代求解器耦合
items.abstract_en: System thermal-hydraulics codes such as the System Analysis Module (SAM) close turbulence on coarse meshes with algebraic zero-equation mixing-length models. These models cannot represent the non-equilibrium turbulence, flow separation, and large-scale recirculation of open-cavity advanced reactors. We develop an invariant neural-network eddy-viscosity closure for SAM and apply it to the Molten Salt Fast Reactor (MSFR). The closure predicts the turbulent kinetic energy and timescale of each element from the flow and geometry of its neighbors, without solving turbulence transport equations. The resulting non-negative eddy viscosity enters the implicit diffusive operator, which keeps the momentum equations well conditioned. We prove that the closure is exactly invariant to translation, Galilean boost, rotation, reflection, and neighbor ordering. A network trained on high-order Nek5000 fields sees a different feature distribution on the coarse SAM mesh. We remove this covariate shift by iteratively retraining the network on SAM flow states against fixed Nek5000 targets. For a held-out steady state, the coupled closure reproduces the single recirculation cell and eddy-viscosity plume of the Nek5000 reference. In a 120 s pump-coastdown transient, it halves the velocity error of the mixing-length model, from 37.6% to 17.7%, and matches the Nek5000 eddy viscosity with a time-averaged relative error of 12%. The remaining velocity error comes from the coarse mesh. The coupled transient takes about 0.2 core-hours, compared with about 330 core-hours for Nek5000. The results show that the closure can recover two-equation RANS turbulence behavior in a coarse-mesh system code at a small fraction of the CFD cost.
items.abstract_zh: 诸如系统分析模块（SAM）之类的系统热工水力代码在粗网格上使用代数零方程混合长度模型来闭合湍流。这些模型无法表征开放腔式先进反应堆的非平衡湍流、流动分离和大尺度回流。我们为 SAM 开发了一种不变神经网络涡黏性闭合，并将其应用于熔盐快堆（MSFR）。该闭合根据每个单元的邻居流动和几何形状预测其湍动能和时间尺度，而无需求解湍流输运方程。所得的非负涡黏性进入隐式扩散算子，使动量方程保持良好条件。我们证明该闭合对平移、伽利略加速、旋转、反射和邻居排序完全不变。在高阶 Nek5000 场中训练的网络在粗 SAM 网格上看到不同的特征分布。我们通过在 SAM 流状态上针对固定的 Nek5000 目标迭代重新训练网络来消除这种协变量偏移。对于留出的稳态，耦合闭合复现了 Nek5000 参考的单个回流单元和涡黏性羽流。在 120 s 泵惰转瞬态中，它将混合长度模型的速度误差减半，从 37.6% 降至 17.7%，并以 12% 的时间平均相对误差匹配 Nek5000 涡黏性。剩余速度误差来自粗网格。耦合瞬态约耗时 0.2 核小时，而 Nek5000 约需 330 核小时。结果表明，该闭合能够以 CFD 成本的一小部分在粗网格系统代码中恢复两方程 RANS 湍流行为。

items.title_en: EvenVLM: A Text and Multimodal Dataset for the Even Language with Vision-Language Fine-Tuning
items.title_zh: EvenVLM：面向埃文语的文本与多模态数据集及视觉-语言微调
items.abstract_en: We present EvenVLM, the first text and multimodal (VQA) dataset for Even (Lamut), an endangered Northern Tungusic language spoken by approximately 6,800 people in Siberia. Our dataset comprises 50,521 structured Even-Russian entries extracted from dictionary and phrasebook sources via GPT-4o Mini-based parsing, from which we synthetically generate 107,543 training examples spanning translation, grammar, reading comprehension, and semantic classification. To address tokenization inefficiency on Even's agglutinative morphology, we propose a three-step tokenizer expansion algorithm that adds Even-specific graphemes (eng, oe, o-umlaut), whitelisted vocabulary, and BPE merges, reducing average tokens per word by 27% (4.99 to 3.64). Using LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen3-VL-4B, we adapt the model for text tasks (0.53% trainable parameters, rank 32) and separately for visual question answering (rank 64, frozen vision encoder). Our best configuration achieves 11.4% exact match and a 13.6 weighted score on text benchmarks, 0.1283 chrF for sentence translation, and 65% accuracy on VQA (up from 0% for the base model and text-only fine-tuning). We release our datasets, evaluation benchmarks, and training pipeline to support further research on Even and other low-resource languages.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 EvenVLM，这是首个面向埃文语（Even，Lamut）的文本与多模态（VQA）数据集；埃文语是一种濒危的北通古斯语，在西伯利亚约有 6,800 人使用。我们的数据集包含 50,521 条结构化的埃文语—俄语条目，通过基于 GPT-4o Mini 的解析从词典和短语集来源中提取，并由此合成生成 107,543 个训练示例，涵盖翻译、语法、阅读理解和语义分类。为解决埃文语黏着形态导致的 tokenization 效率问题，我们提出一种三步分词器扩展算法，添加埃文语特定字素（eng、oe、o-umlaut）、白名单词汇和 BPE 合并，使每词平均 token 数减少 27%（从 4.99 降至 3.64）。使用 Qwen3-VL-4B 的 LoRA 微调，我们分别针对文本任务（0.53% 可训练参数，rank 32）和视觉问答（rank 64，冻结视觉编码器）适配模型。我们的最佳配置在文本基准上达到 11.4% 精确匹配和 13.6 加权分数，句子翻译的 chrF 为 0.1283，VQA 准确率为 65%（基础模型和仅文本微调为 0%）。我们发布数据集、评估基准和训练流程，以支持对埃文语及其他低资源语言的进一步研究。

items.title_en: Informative Path Planning with Gaussian Processes: Error Bounds, Algorithms, and Benchmarks
items.title_zh: 基于高斯过程的信息路径规划：误差界、算法与基准
items.abstract_en: Accurate environmental monitoring relies on Informative Path Planning (IPP) to deploy autonomous systems that maximize information gain. While Gaussian Processes (GPs) provide a robust mathematical foundation for modeling the environment, contemporary IPP approaches remain hindered by heuristic operational constraints and the lack of simultaneous theoretical guarantees for worst-case estimation error and approximation quality. Rather than introducing yet another heuristic, this paper presents a rigorous theoretical analysis of existing error bounds and algorithms to further develop the mathematical foundation for IPP. By evaluating probabilistic and deterministic bounds on reconstruction error, we establish that predictive variance is the theoretically ideal optimization objective for GP-based IPP. Furthermore, we analyze GreedyCover, a recent approach for optimizing predictive variance, and demonstrate that its near-optimal approximation guarantee matches the fundamental hardness-of-approximation limit for the problem. Comprehensive benchmarking confirms that this approach delivers superior estimation accuracy and computational efficiency compared to prominent information-theoretic objectives and optimization methods used in IPP. Finally, this theoretical analysis establishes a rigorous, near-optimal foundation for discrete offline IPP under bounded uncertainty constraints, offering clear and principled guidance for future work in continuous-space and online formulations.
items.abstract_zh: 准确的环境监测依赖信息路径规划（IPP）来部署自主系统以最大化信息增益。虽然高斯过程（GP）为环境建模提供了稳健的数学基础，但当代 IPP 方法仍受制于启发式运行约束，并且缺乏对最坏情况估计误差和近似质量的同时理论保证。本文不引入又一个启发式方法，而是对现有误差界和算法进行严格理论分析，以进一步发展 IPP 的数学基础。通过评估重建误差的概率界和确定性界，我们确立预测方差是基于 GP 的 IPP 在理论上理想的优化目标。此外，我们分析 GreedyCover——一种近期用于优化预测方差的方法——并证明其近最优近似保证与该问题的基本近似硬度极限相匹配。综合基准测试确认，与 IPP 中使用的著名信息论目标和优化方法相比，该方法具有更优的估计精度和计算效率。最后，该理论分析为有界不确定性约束下的离散离线 IPP 建立了严格、近最优的基础，并为连续空间和在线表述的未来工作提供了清晰且有原则的指导。

items.title_en: Transmission-Mode Multispectral Imaging for Estimation of Microcystis spp. Cell Concentration and ELISA-Equivalent Microcystin Concentration in Water
items.title_zh: 透射模式多光谱成像用于估算水中微囊藻属细胞浓度和ELISA等效微囊藻毒素浓度
items.abstract_en: Harmful algal blooms dominated by Microcystis spp. threaten freshwater systems through proliferation and microcystin (MC) production. Conventional measurements of cyanobacterial abundance and MC concentration commonly require laboratory processing, specialized instrumentation, or assay reagents. Because MC concentration cannot always be reliably inferred from cell abundance, complementary optical approaches for estimating both quantities are of interest. This study proposes and evaluates a transmission mode multispectral imaging (MSI) framework for estimating Microcystis spp. cell concentration and ELISA-equivalent MC concentration from culture derived dilution samples. A custom built MSI system acquiring twelve spectral bands from near-ultraviolet to near-infrared wavelengths measured transmitted light spectral responses. Following principal component analysis based dimensionality reduction, spectral variation was quantified using an aggregated Wasserstein distance descriptor for regression based prediction. Cell concentration estimation yielded $R^2=0.9819$ for calibration and $R^2=0.9754$ on held-out intermediate dilution levels, while ELISA-equivalent MC estimation yielded $R^2=0.9788$ for calibration and $R^2=0.9786$ on held-out intermediate dilution levels. These results demonstrate the feasibility of transmission-mode MSI as a dual output optical calibration framework for estimation of Microcystis spp. cell concentration and ELISA-equivalent MC concentration in water.
items.abstract_zh: 以微囊藻属为主的有害藻华通过增殖和微囊藻毒素（MC）产生威胁淡水系统。蓝细菌丰度和MC浓度的常规测量通常需要实验室处理、专用仪器或检测试剂。由于MC浓度并不总能由细胞丰度可靠推断，因此人们对用于估算这两种量的互补光学方法感兴趣。本研究提出并评估了一个透射模式多光谱成像（MSI）框架，用于从培养物来源的稀释样本中估算微囊藻属细胞浓度和ELISA等效MC浓度。一套定制MSI系统采集从近紫外到近红外波长的十二个光谱波段，测量透射光光谱响应。在基于主成分分析的降维之后，使用聚合Wasserstein距离描述符量化光谱变异，用于基于回归的预测。细胞浓度估算在校准中得到R^2=0.9819，在留出的中间稀释水平上得到R^2=0.9754；ELISA等效MC估算在校准中得到R^2=0.9788，在留出的中间稀释水平上得到R^2=0.9786。这些结果证明了透射模式MSI作为一种双输出光学校准框架，用于估算水中微囊藻属细胞浓度和ELISA等效MC浓度的可行性。
authors: K. A. D. S. A. Perera

items.title_en: Spindle: Scalable Indexing of Spatial-Omics Data for Fast Querying
items.title_zh: Spindle：面向快速查询的空间组学数据可扩展索引
items.abstract_en: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) has unlocked new avenues for biological discovery by jointly capturing gene expression and spatial context. ST datasets are typically stored as gene expression matrices paired with spatial coordinates, supporting queries based on expression levels at individual locations. However, characterizing how genes vary together requires representations of relationships between genes, such as covariance matrices computed over spatial neighborhoods. These gene--gene co-expression patterns capture coordinated biological variation and can reveal spatially localized gene programs. As datasets grow to atlas scale, efficiently searching for such patterns becomes a central computational bottleneck due to the combination of high dimensionality, extreme sparsity, and variability in gene expression across large numbers of spatial regions. Such searches require repeated access to second-order statistics, motivating a compact, searchable representation of spatial co-expression. We address this problem with Spindle, a platform-agnostic indexing algorithm for efficiently searching spatial gene co-expression patterns. Spindle exploits the approximate block-diagonal structure of gene--gene covariance matrices over spatial regions, in which covariances between blocks are small in magnitude, to selectively store informative components while compactly representing recurring covariance patterns. This yields a compressed yet searchable index suitable for atlas-scale spatial datasets. Across multiple real-world biological datasets (87,000--817,000 cells), Spindle indexes are 113--197 times smaller than the whole covariance matrices. A complete query, including query preprocessing, takes 2.8--28 ms on one CPU core, 5.1--16 times faster than a scan over the whole covariance matrices, and the tiles it returns recover a median of 81% of the exact near neighbors. In breast cancer, the regions retrieved by covariance search closely match the cell-type composition of the query (median cell-type composition difference 0.15, compared with 0.54 for random regions). Spindle supports both partial covariance queries and queries specified as gene lists, as well as retrieval across measurement platforms.
items.abstract_zh: 空间转录组学（ST）通过同时捕获基因表达和空间背景，为生物发现开辟了新途径。ST数据集通常存储为与空间坐标配对的基因表达矩阵，支持基于单个位置表达水平的查询。然而，刻画基因如何共同变化需要基因之间关系的表示，例如在空间邻域上计算的协方差矩阵。这些基因--基因共表达模式捕获协调的生物学变异，并可揭示空间定位的基因程序。随着数据集增长到图谱规模，由于高维度、极端稀疏性以及大量空间区域中基因表达的可变性，高效搜索此类模式成为核心计算瓶颈。此类搜索需要重复访问二阶统计量，这促使人们采用紧凑、可搜索的空间共表达表示。我们通过Spindle来解决这一问题，这是一种平台无关的索引算法，用于高效搜索空间基因共表达模式。Spindle利用空间区域上基因--基因协方差矩阵的近似块对角结构，其中块间协方差幅度较小，从而选择性存储信息丰富的成分，同时紧凑表示反复出现的协方差模式。这产生了一个适用于图谱规模空间数据集的压缩且可搜索的索引。在多个真实生物数据集（87,000--817,000个细胞）上，Spindle索引比整个协方差矩阵小113--197倍。一次完整查询（包括查询预处理）在单个CPU核心上耗时2.8--28 ms，比扫描整个协方差矩阵快5.1--16倍，其返回的瓦片可恢复精确近邻的中位数为81%。在乳腺癌中，通过协方差搜索检索到的区域与查询的细胞类型组成密切匹配（细胞类型组成差异中位数为0.15，而随机区域为0.54）。Spindle支持部分协方差查询和以基因列表指定的查询，以及跨测量平台的检索。

items.title_en: Exact characterization of three-terminal fermion counting under one-body scattering
items.title_zh: 单体力散射下三端费米子计数的精确表征
items.abstract_en: Quantum scattering is a fundamental probe of the scattering region and the quantum dynamics of outgoing particles. In two terminals, the statistics of non-interacting fermions is described by a generalized binomial distribution, that arises from the Pauli exclusion principle, while deviations are a signature of interactions. In this work, we extend this result to a scattering region coupled to three outgoing terminals (or channels), obtaining exact bounds for the statistics of the outgoing fermions. In particular, for two fermions and three terminals, four inequalities involving six measured probabilities determine whether a non-interacting scatterer can explain the observed statistics. Applying these inequalities to recent scattering experiments in cold atoms, we are able to identify a regime where interactions have a significant contribution on the outgoing particles. Therefore, our work opens up the possibility of identifying fermion interactions at the nanoscale in systems that range from mesoscopic conductors to optical traps in cold atoms.
items.abstract_zh: 量子散射是探测散射区以及出射粒子量子动力学的基本手段。在两端情形下，非相互作用费米子的统计由泡利不相容原理产生的广义二项分布描述，而偏离则成为相互作用的标志。在本工作中，我们将这一结果推广到与三个出射端（或通道）耦合的散射区，获得出射费米子统计的精确界。特别地，对于两个费米子和三个端，涉及六个测量概率的四个不等式决定了非相互作用散射体能否解释观测到的统计。将这些不等式应用于近期冷原子散射实验，我们能够识别出相互作用对出射粒子有显著贡献的区间。因此，我们的工作为在从介观导体到冷原子光阱的系统中于纳米尺度识别费米子相互作用开辟了可能性。

items.title_en: Flexible Intelligent Metasurfaces for Enhancing Secure MISO Communications
items.title_zh: 用于增强安全MISO通信的柔性智能超表面
items.abstract_en: This letter investigates flexible intelligent metasurface (FIM)-aided secure multiple-input single-output (MISO) communications in the presence of a multi-antenna eavesdropper. By exploiting the morphing capability of the FIM, the transmit array geometry can be dynamically reconfigured to reshape the legitimate and eavesdropping channels. We formulate a secrecy rate maximization (SRM) problem by jointly optimizing the transmit covariance matrix and the FIM surface shape. For a given FIM surface shape, the optimal transmit covariance matrix is shown to be rank one and is obtained in closed form from the dominant generalized eigenvector. For a fixed transmit covariance matrix, a projected gradient ascent (PGA) method is developed to optimize the FIM shape. Based on these two subproblems, a block coordinate ascent (BCA) algorithm is proposed. Moreover, for the special line-of-sight (LoS) scenario, we derive a globally optimal closed-form joint transmit covariance matrix and FIM surface shape design under a sufficient morphing-range condition. Numerical results demonstrate that FIM effectively improves the secrecy rate over a conventional rigid antenna array (RAA). Moreover, FIM achieves a transmit-power saving of about 2.5 dB compared with the RAA benchmark at the same secrecy rate.
items.abstract_zh: 本文研究在多天线窃听者存在下，由柔性智能超表面（FIM）辅助的安全多输入单输出（MISO）通信。利用FIM的形变能力，可以动态重构发射阵列几何，以重塑合法信道和窃听信道。我们通过联合优化发射协方差矩阵和FIM表面形状，构建了保密速率最大化（SRM）问题。对于给定FIM表面形状，最优发射协方差矩阵被证明为秩一，并由主广义特征向量以闭式获得。对于固定发射协方差矩阵，开发了投影梯度上升（PGA）方法来优化FIM形状。基于这两个子问题，提出了块坐标上升（BCA）算法。此外，对于特殊的视距（LoS）场景，我们在充分形变范围条件下推导了全局最优的闭式联合发射协方差矩阵和FIM表面形状设计。数值结果表明，FIM相较传统刚性天线阵列（RAA）有效提高了保密速率。此外，在相同保密速率下，FIM相较RAA基准实现了约2.5 dB的发射功率节省。

items.title_en: Benchmarking Multilingual Document Understanding in Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: 视觉-语言模型中多语言文档理解的基准测试
items.abstract_en: Recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform strongly on multimodal tasks, Document Understanding (DU) among them, but the benchmarks that measure them mostly cover English documents and narrow problems. How well current VLMs generalize across languages, tasks, styles and layouts therefore remains unclear. We introduce MDU, a multilingual DU benchmark of 23146 examples spanning 13 tasks and five languages: English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish. The tasks isolate complementary capabilities, from surface-level text and Markdown extraction through summarization, classification and named-entity recognition to layout-sensitive passage and layout extraction. We evaluate 45 state-of-the-art open-weight VLMs from 1.7B to 235B parameters, plus one commercial system under the same protocol. The benchmark is far from saturated: the best average is 69.0, only eight of the 45 evaluated systems reach 65, and the two best results come from 27B models rather than from the largest systems we evaluate. Performance is uneven in ways that scale does not fix. The gap between the strongest and weakest language does not close as models grow, and it survives controlling for the domain composition of each language. Capabilities also do not improve together: once we partial out overall model quality, per-task scores are largely uncorrelated, and transcription ability in particular trades off against semantic extraction.
items.abstract_zh: 近期视觉-语言模型（VLM）在多模态任务上表现强劲，文档理解（DU）是其中之一，但衡量它们的基准大多覆盖英文文档和狭窄问题。因此，当前VLM在语言、任务、风格和版式之间的泛化能力仍不清楚。我们提出MDU，一个多语言DU基准，包含23146个示例，涵盖13项任务和五种语言：英语、法语、德语、意大利语和西班牙语。这些任务分离互补能力，从表面级文本和Markdown抽取，到摘要、分类和命名实体识别，再到对版式敏感的段落抽取和版式抽取。我们在相同协议下评估了45个参数从1.7B到235B的最先进开放权重VLM，以及一个商业系统。该基准远未饱和：最佳平均分为69.0，45个被评估系统中仅八个达到65，且两个最佳结果来自27B模型，而不是我们评估的最大系统。性能不均衡的方式并非规模所能解决。最强与最弱语言之间的差距并不随模型增大而缩小，并且在控制各语言领域构成后仍然存在。能力也并非共同提升：在剔除整体模型质量后，各任务得分基本不相关，尤其是转写能力与语义抽取之间存在权衡。

items.title_en: DroneDiffusion: Uncertainty-Guided Diffusion Path Planner for UAV Navigation
items.title_zh: DroneDiffusion：面向无人机导航的不确定性引导扩散路径规划器
items.abstract_en: We present DroneDiffusion, a perception-aware diffusion planner for local 3-D UAV trajectory generation that explicitly models and avoids failure zones caused by lens flare, overexposure, and reflective surfaces. A vision-language perceptual safety estimator produces a pixel-aligned reliability map that highlights regions of degraded sensing. A denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) is conditioned on this map together with the onboard RGB image, goal point, and initial velocity to generate egocentric 3-D trajectories. To enforce obstacle avoidance at inference time without retraining, we apply training-free CHOMP guidance over a 3-D Euclidean signed distance field. The model is trained entirely in simulation and deployed zero-shot on a real drone. Reliability conditioning raises the mean perceptual reliability along generated trajectories to 0.71, compared with 0.63 for a geometric baseline, while guidance halves the collision rate of the learned prior from 14.7% to 7.8%. Perceptual safety conditioning and geometric guidance are therefore complementary: treating sensor reliability as a first-class signal reduces incursions into unreliable regions while maintaining competitive navigation performance.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出DroneDiffusion，一种感知感知型扩散规划器，用于局部三维无人机轨迹生成，显式建模并避开由镜头眩光、过曝和反射表面造成的失效区域。视觉-语言感知安全估计器生成像素对齐的可靠性图，突出显示感知退化区域。去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）以该图连同机载RGB图像、目标点和初始速度为条件，生成以机体为中心的三维轨迹。为了在推理时无需重新训练即可强制执行避障，我们在三维欧氏符号距离场上应用免训练CHOMP引导。该模型完全在仿真中训练，并零样本部署到真实无人机上。可靠性条件化将生成轨迹上的平均感知可靠性提高到0.71，而几何基线为0.63；引导将学习先验的碰撞率从14.7%减半至7.8%。因此，感知安全条件化和几何引导是互补的：将传感器可靠性视为一等信号可减少进入不可靠区域的侵入，同时保持有竞争力的导航性能。

items.title_en: Learning the Missing Derivative: Neural Multiple-Scattering Operators for Inverse Volume Rendering
items.title_zh: 学习缺失的导数：用于逆体积渲染的神经多重散射算子
items.abstract_en: Reconstructing optically thick media from photographs requires modeling multiple scattering and its response to changes in extinction. Frozen-source tomography discards this derivative; differentiable path tracing estimates it through expensive, noisy sampling. We instead predict the multiple-scattering field with a neural operator and differentiate through it during inverse rendering, while computing transmittance and single scattering directly. A further challenge arises during optimization: an operator that predicts the field accurately on held-out media can still produce poor derivatives at the density states visited by the optimizer. We address this by fine-tuning on states generated during inversions driven by the operator, using Monte Carlo scattering-field supervision. On held-out optically thick clouds, our method improves relighting over frozen-source tomography at equal time and outperforms differentiable path tracing given substantially more time. Training on inversion trajectories also improves derivative alignment at visited states and reduces optimization drift.
items.abstract_zh: 从照片重建光学厚介质需要建模多重散射及其对消光变化的响应。冻结源层析成像丢弃了这一导数；可微路径追踪通过昂贵且含噪的采样来估计它。我们改用神经算子预测多重散射场，并在逆渲染过程中通过该算子进行微分，同时直接计算透射率和单次散射。优化过程中还会出现进一步挑战：一个在留出介质上能准确预测场的算子，在优化器访问的密度状态下仍可能产生较差的导数。我们通过在由该算子驱动的反演过程中生成的状态上进行微调，并使用蒙特卡洛散射场监督来解决这一问题。在留出的光学厚云上，我们的方法在相同时间下相较冻结源层析成像改进了重光照，并在给予显著更多时间时优于可微路径追踪。在反演轨迹上训练还改善了访问状态处的导数对齐，并减少了优化漂移。

items.title_en: Monocyte-to-lymphocyte and Platelet-to-lymphocyte ratios in Neuromyelitis Optica Spectrum Disorders: systematic review and meta-analysis
items.title_zh: 视神经脊髓炎谱系疾病中的单核细胞与淋巴细胞比值及血小板与淋巴细胞比值：系统综述与荟萃分析
items.abstract_en: Background: Neuromyelitis Optica Spectrum Disorders (NMOSD) are a group of neuroinflammatory conditions that affect the nervous system. MLR and PLR are simple inflammatory biomarkers and are studied in many autoimmune and demyelinating diseases. In this study, we investigate the available evidence to determine whether MLR and PLR are higher in NMOSD patients than in healthy subjects. Methods: Systematic review and meta-analysis of studies measuring levels of PLR and/or MLR in both NMOSD patients and healthy controls were conducted. Mean difference (MD) and 95% confidence interval (CI) were used to measure the difference in levels of MLR and PLR between patients and healthy subjects. Results: For MLR, the main meta-analysis yielded a pooled MD of 0.125 [-0.114; 0.363]. I2 was 83.8%. Subgroup meta-analysis of age- and sex-matched studies, demonstrated a pooled MD of 0.066 [0.012; 0.12]. For PLR, meta-analysis revealed a pooled MD of 23.99 [6.03; 41.96]. I2 was 82.3%. Subgroup analysis for age- and sex-matched studies for PLR, showed a pooled MD of 14 [-19.68; 47.68]. Conclusion: The main analysis suggests that MLR is not higher in NMOSD patients than in healthy controls. However, subgroup analysis of age- and sex-matched studies and leave-one-out analysis excluding the outlier study showed a statistically significant MLR increase in patients. PLR was found to exhibit a modest increase in NMOSD patients compared with healthy controls. Nonetheless, subgroup analysis of age- and sex-matched studies showed a statistically non-significant increase. Results should be interpreted cautiously. The available evidence is inconsistent and further research is needed.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：视神经脊髓炎谱系疾病（NMOSD）是一组影响神经系统的神经炎性疾病。MLR 和 PLR 是简单的炎症生物标志物，已在许多自身免疫性疾病和脱髓鞘疾病中研究。在本研究中，我们调查现有证据，以确定 NMOSD 患者的 MLR 和 PLR 是否高于健康受试者。方法：对测量 NMOSD 患者和健康对照者 PLR 和/或 MLR 水平的研究进行系统综述与荟萃分析。使用均数差（MD）和95%置信区间（CI）衡量患者与健康受试者之间 MLR 和 PLR 水平的差异。结果：对于 MLR，主荟萃分析得出合并 MD 为 0.125 [-0.114; 0.363]，I2 为 83.8%。对年龄和性别匹配研究的亚组荟萃分析显示，合并 MD 为 0.066 [0.012; 0.12]。对于 PLR，荟萃分析显示合并 MD 为 23.99 [6.03; 41.96]，I2 为 82.3%。对 PLR 的年龄和性别匹配研究进行亚组分析，显示合并 MD 为 14 [-19.68; 47.68]。结论：主分析提示 NMOSD 患者的 MLR 并不高于健康对照者。然而，对年龄和性别匹配研究的亚组分析以及排除离群研究后的留一法分析显示，患者 MLR 升高具有统计学意义。研究发现，与健康对照者相比，NMOSD 患者的 PLR 呈现轻度升高。尽管如此，对年龄和性别匹配研究的亚组分析显示，该升高无统计学意义。结果应谨慎解读。现有证据不一致，需要进一步研究。

items.title_en: UV and deep-UV ultrafast harmonic generation enhanced by resonant gold nano-pillar metasurface
items.title_zh: 共振金纳米柱超表面增强的紫外与深紫外超快谐波产生
items.abstract_en: We report experimental observations and full-vector numerical simulations of second and third-harmonic generation from a two-dimensional periodic gold nano-pillar metasurface, for efficient ultrafast light conversion from near-infrared to the UV and deep-UV spectral ranges. The metasurface is designed to support an angle-tunable plasmonic resonance in the near-infrared spectral range, with its resonance wavelength shifting as a function of the pump angle of incidence. Under resonant conditions, strong electromagnetic-field confinement near the nano-pillar corners enhances the nonlinear light-matter interactions. Compared with a flat gold mirror, the nanostructured metal exhibits enhanced nonlinear frequency conversion, with conversion efficiencies of second and third-harmonic generation increased by two and three orders of magnitude, respectively. Full-wave theoretical modeling of linear and nonlinear light-matter interaction in nanoscale structures validates the experimental results. We demonstrate that periodically arranged square gold pillars can be engineered to achieve enhanced second and third-harmonic generation at wavelengths that can be tailored through the structural design, without requiring complex geometries or hybrid structures that pose fabrication challenges. The close agreement between theoretical predictions and experimental measurements further advances our understanding of surface-mediated nonlinear optical processes in metals and highlights the potential of metallic nanostructures as ultrafast light sources in the UV and deep-UV.
items.abstract_zh: 我们报道了二维周期金纳米柱超表面二次和三次谐波产生的实验观测与全矢量数值模拟，用于从近红外到紫外和深紫外光谱范围的高效超快光转换。该超表面设计为在近红外光谱范围内支持角度可调的表面等离激元共振，其共振波长随泵浦入射角变化而移动。在共振条件下，纳米柱角附近强电磁场约束增强了非线性光-物质相互作用。与平坦金镜相比，纳米结构金属表现出增强的非线性频率转换，二次和三次谐波产生的转换效率分别提高了两个和三个数量级。对纳米结构中线性和非线性光-物质相互作用的全波理论建模验证了实验结果。我们证明，周期排列的方形金柱可通过工程设计在可由结构设计定制的波长处实现增强的二次和三次谐波产生，而无需会带来制造挑战的复杂几何结构或混合结构。理论预测与实验测量之间的高度一致进一步推进了我们对金属中表面介导非线性光学过程的理解，并凸显了金属纳米结构作为紫外和深紫外超快光源的潜力。

items.title_en: MutAtlas: A PDB-Wide Energy-Guided Atlas of Protein Mutation Effects
items.title_zh: MutAtlas：覆盖整个PDB的能量引导蛋白质突变效应图谱
items.abstract_en: Protein mutation effect prediction is fundamental to protein engineering and disease variant interpretation, yet experimentally measured mutation data remain accurate but extremely sparse. To provide scalable supplementary mutation signals, we construct a PDB-wide mutation augmentation dataset that exhaustively enumerates single-site substitutions on experimentally resolved protein structures and aligns mutation signals from physics-based energy models, protein language models, and inverse folding models. Large-scale analysis under a unified mutation preference representation reveals substantial differences in the consistency, concentration, and substitution patterns of mutation distributions across models, indicating that disagreement is pervasive and reflects conflicting inductive biases rather than random noise. Motivated by these observations, we propose an unsupervised multi-source mutation preference distillation framework that learns from relative mutation preferences while explicitly modeling cross-source disagreement. Without using any experimental mutation labels during training, our approach achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated zero-shot baselines and naive multi-source fusion strategies on ProteinGym. We release the dataset and evaluation pipeline to support reproducible studies of protein mutation effects.
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质突变效应预测是蛋白质工程和疾病变异解读的基础，但实验测量的突变数据虽然准确却极其稀疏。为提供可扩展的补充突变信号，我们构建了一个覆盖整个PDB的突变增强数据集，该数据集穷举实验解析蛋白质结构上的单位点替换，并对齐来自基于物理的能量模型、蛋白质语言模型和逆折叠模型的突变信号。在统一的突变偏好表示下进行的大规模分析揭示，不同模型的突变分布在一致性、集中度和替换模式上存在显著差异，表明分歧普遍存在，并反映相互冲突的归纳偏置而非随机噪声。受这些观察启发，我们提出一个无监督多源突变偏好蒸馏框架，该框架从相对突变偏好中学习，同时显式建模跨源分歧。在训练期间不使用任何实验突变标签的情况下，我们的方法在ProteinGym上于所评估的零样本基线和朴素多源融合策略中取得最佳总体性能。我们发布该数据集和评估流程，以支持可重复的蛋白质突变效应研究。
